Only reads may use it; a write names the shop in the header (else a 422 on `shop`). A header and a query naming two different shops are a 422 too.

Migration.name: migration
Migration.description: A move of the server's services (`ServerMigrationRow.id`)

TextKey.name: key
TextKey.description: A text's key (`BotTextRow.key`) from the shop's list. An agent's shop has no agency texts (404).

Search.name: search
Search.description: The search text ("#12" finds by number)

Status.name: status
Status.description: The status tab. Empty for all

Dir.name: dir
Dir.description: The sort direction. Default `desc` (newest or largest first)

From.name: from
From.description: The first day to include, in the shop's time zone

To.name: to
To.description: The last day to include, in the shop's time zone

Customer.name: user
Customer.description: A customer's id: only their rows (their page links here)

Store.name: store
Store.description: The website's store key, which names the shop. Not a secret; the panel shows it with the base address and can replace it

TransferKey.name: Idempotency-Key
TransferKey.description: A key the website makes for each «انتقال موجودی» the customer confirms (a UUID): 1 to 64 Latin letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Repeating the request with the same key (a network retry) answers the transfer the key made, never a second one — even when two arrive at the same moment. The same key with another `telegram_id` or `amount` is a 422 on `idempotency_key`; so is a missing or malformed key. A key is the customer's for good: a new transfer takes a new key.

ManualOrderKey.name: Idempotency-Key
ManualOrderKey.description: A key the panel makes for each order support makes by hand (a UUID), and a new one after a refusal: 1 to 64 Latin letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Repeating the request with the same key (a network retry) returns the order the key made, as it is now: never a second order or charge, and never refused for what changed since (the wallet it charged, the name it took). Two identical requests at the same moment get one order. A key already used for another order of the customer's, or for another way to pay, is a 422 on `idempotency_key`; so is a missing or malformed key. A key is remembered for a week.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A key the website makes for each checkout attempt (a UUID), and a new one when the customer picks another payment method: 1 to 64 Latin letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Repeating the request with the same key and `method_id` (a network retry) returns the order the key led to, either the one it created or the open order for the same thing it found and paid, as it is now. Never a second order or charge, whatever changed since: even after a price change it is the order made at the old price. Two identical requests at the same moment get one order and one answer. If the order was cancelled since (by support, or left unpaid past its deadline, maybe days ago), the answer is a 409 with its own message («این سفارش لغو شده است…»), unlike the 409 for an order closed elsewhere a moment ago: buying again is a new attempt with a new key. A key already used for a different order (another type, plan, server or service, or a top-up of another amount), or first sent with another `method_id`, is a 422 on `idempotency_key`; so is a missing or malformed key. A key is remembered for a week; after that, a request with it counts as new.

Error.description: A refusal or failure, in the common error shape

SignedOut.description: No valid session for this shop: no bearer token, an ended session (the `customer` scheme lists what ends one), or another shop's token. The message is «برای دسترسی باید وارد شوید.» and the customer must sign in again. A 401 never means the request itself was refused (that is another 4xx; a proof that does not hold is a 422 on its field), so a website can treat every 401 here as signed out.

WWW-Authenticate.description: `Bearer` (RFC 6750): the operation needs a bearer token.

SignInAgain.description: The session's sign-in is too old to change how the account signs in, or to hand a service to another customer. The message is «برای این کار دوباره وارد شوید.»; proving a way in again (`POST /me/reauthenticate`) allows it for 15 minutes. (A banned customer's 403 says so in its message, without this header.)

WWW-Authenticate.description: `Bearer error="insufficient_user_authentication", max_age=900` (RFC 9470): the sign-in may be at most this many seconds old.

StaffRefused.description: The website's admin API refused the request. The reasons: the customer is not an admin of the shop («این بخش فقط برای پشتیبانی فروشگاه است.»); the website lets no admins in; the session was signed in with a password alone while the website asks for a strong sign-in (`WWW-Authenticate` names the strong ways, and `POST /me/reauthenticate` can prove one); the session's sign-in is older than 12 hours (any operation; SignInAgain's challenge); the website has not granted the operation; a granted operation, or a payment approval, with a sign-in older than 15 minutes (SignInAgain's challenge); a decision about the admin themselves (their own payment approved or refunded, their own wallet, their own service changed: days and traffic, switched off or on, moved, deleted); another admin's or an agent's account; a payment approved without a receipt in review; or a banned customer.

WWW-Authenticate.description: `Bearer error="insufficient_user_authentication", acr_values="telegram google password_2fa"` (RFC 9470) for a sign-in that is too weak; `Bearer error="insufficient_user_authentication", max_age=900` for one that is too old; absent otherwise.

Receipt.description: A receipt's bytes: inline for a picture the panel can show, otherwise a download (attachment)

TicketPicture.description: A ticket message's picture: inline for a picture type, otherwise a download (attachment)

ErrorResponse.description: The shape of every refusal and failure, whatever produced it. A 429 also sends the wait in seconds in `Retry-After`.

message.description: A message for the reader: the admin on the panels, the customer on the Store API.

errors.description: Field errors, keyed by the field they are about

request_id.description: The request's id, the same as the `X-Request-Id` header and the id on every log line of the request. The panel shows it on a server failure («کد پیگیری») so the request can be found in the log.

debug.description: Debug details. Only on a server failure (a 500, never a refusal), with APP_DEBUG on, and only for a request made directly from the server's own machine (never one forwarded by a proxy or tunnel). Paths are relative to the app's folder; call arguments are never included.

PageMeta.description: A paged list's position. A sorted list's meta also has its order (`sort`, `dir`).

SortDirection.description: The sort direction. `asc` puts the oldest, smallest or soonest first; `desc` the reverse.

UserRef.description: A reference to a customer, as every screen shows one: their id, the three Telegram identifiers kept separate (a customer who signed up on the website has only a name), and their email.

name.description: "first last" from Telegram, or as they signed up with; null when the account has none.

username.description: Telegram handle without "@"; null when the account has none.

telegram_id.description: Their Telegram user id; null for a customer who signed up on the website (the bot cannot message them).

email.description: Their verified email, in lower case; null when they have none.

WholeNumberInput.description: A whole number as a form sends it: a JSON number, or text (Persian or Arabic digits accepted).

AmountInput.description: An amount as a form sends it: a JSON number, or text (Persian or Arabic digits and thousands separators accepted). Toman are whole numbers: the API's own output form "120000.00" is accepted, any other fraction is refused. Gigabytes may have up to two decimals.

NumbersInput.description: A short list of whole numbers, such as the amounts a screen offers as buttons. A list, or text as the admin types it ("50, 100, 200", or separated by spaces; a comma between groups of three digits is a thousands separator, so "50,000, 100,000" is two numbers). Stored without repeats, smallest first.

NoteRequest.description: Support's note to the customer with a decision (a cancellation, a rejection, a service switched off, an agency refused or ended). It is a separate line of the message they get. At most 300 characters; blank for none.

RefundRequest.description: Support's note on a refund. It is a line of the message the customer gets and the description of the wallet line the refund writes, so at most 190 characters (a ledger line's limit). Blank for none.

ReorderRequest.description: The rows of an admin-ordered list in their new order, by id. At most 1000.

ActivationRequest.description: A row's on/off switch (a plan, a category). A JSON boolean only.

database.description: Never the reason; that is in the log.

AppInfo.description: The answer of `GET /api/app`, which the panels call first.

name.description: The shop's name (APP_NAME).

installed.description: False until the web installer has finished; the panel then shows the installer.

timezone.description: The shop's time zone (APP_TIMEZONE, an IANA name such as Asia/Tehran). The panels show every date and time in it, as the bot does.

FieldType.description: A field's kind, which decides how a generic form draws it: a line of text, a whole number, an amount of Toman, a short list of numbers typed as text, an on/off switch, one of a few values, a secret, an email address, a web address, a file path, a few lines of text, or a bank card number (drawn in groups of four and sent as digits).

FieldDescription.description: One field of a driver's form, described for a generic form (`Field::describe()`), so the screens need no driver-specific code.

name.description: The key the value is sent under, and the field a 422 names.

hint.description: The help line under the field.

required.description: The form is refused when it is empty. For a secret: a value must end up stored, and a blank one keeps the stored value.

secret.description: Never sent back (its value is a SecretState). Left blank or out, the stored value stays; `clear_<name>: true` empties it.

bound_to.description: For a secret: the fields it belongs with. When one of them changes, a blank secret is refused (with the `moved` message) and must be typed again or cleared.

moved.description: The server's message for a blank secret after a field it belongs with changed; show it as a hint before saving.

options.description: A choice's values and their labels, in order.

when.description: The field is shown (and read, and required if it is) only while each named earlier field holds one of these values: a switch as "true" or "false", a number as its digits. While hidden, its stored value is kept.

unit.description: Shown after a number, such as «ثانیه».

min.description: The smallest value of a number, an amount, or each item of a list.

ltr.description: Latin content (a host, a username), drawn left to right like numbers, secrets, emails, web addresses and paths.

default.description: The value while nothing is stored; null for a secret.

DriverDescription.description: A driver (a database, a mail transport, a panel connector, a payment gateway, a captcha) as the panels show it (`Descriptor::toArray()`): its key, label and description, and its form with every field described.

key.description: The name config.php, a database row or a request uses for it.

notes.description: Short notes under the description, such as required versions and caveats.

traits.description: Extra facts specific to the driver's family. A database driver: `installable` (the installer offers it). A mail driver: `sender` (which address it can send from, as text). A payment gateway: `kind` (`instant`, settling at once like the wallet, or `manual`, a card transfer whose receipt a person approves) and `builtin` (part of every shop; never added or deleted). A panel connector: `mark` (the two letters on its card), `vendor`, `docs_url` (its project's address), `inbounds` (services are sold on inbounds the owner picks; without it a server is sold whole) and `link_rotation` («تغییر لینک»). A captcha driver has none.

DriverValues.description: A driver's field values by name, as a screen shows them (`Form::present()`): the stored values, else the defaults. A secret is a SecretState, never the secret itself.

DatabaseSettings.description: The database settings in config.php: the driver DB_CONNECTION names, the drivers the admin may pick (each described with its form), and the chosen driver's stored values.

driver.description: The chosen driver (`DriverDescription.key`) named in config.php.

drivers.description: The installable drivers, plus the one the shop runs on

DatabaseRequest.description: The database settings as a form sends them (the installer's step, and the settings screen's save and test): the driver (one of `drivers`) and its form's fields by name, as typed. A secret left blank or out keeps the stored one while the address it was given for stays the same (the installer has nothing stored, so it is empty); `clear_<name>: true` empties it. One closed shape per driver.

DatabaseMysqlRequest.description: MySQL or MariaDB: the server, the account, the database and an optional table prefix.

password.description: Left out or blank: the stored password stays, as long as the host, port and socket stay the same.

path.description: The file's path, relative to the application folder or absolute; never under public/.

InstallStatus.description: The installation's progress. The answer of `GET /api/install` and of every installer step.

optional.description: Not needed to run the shop (only the panel's self-update needs it). Shown, but blocks nothing.

database.description: The database step's settings, and whether the database config.php names answers (not checked before the step has written one).

driver.description: The chosen driver (`DriverDescription.key`) named in config.php.

drivers.description: The installable drivers, plus the one the shop runs on

error.description: Why the database does not answer, for the admin

InstallAdminRequest.description: The panel's login: a username of 2 to 64 letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `@` or `-`, and a password of at least 8 characters and at most 72 bytes, typed twice.

password.description: As typed; spaces at either end are part of it.

InstallSiteRequest.description: The shop's name and public address (APP_NAME, APP_URL), and optionally the main bot's token, which is saved once Telegram confirms which bot it belongs to.

url.description: An http(s) address, including any sub-folder.

token.description: From @BotFather. Blank or left out to set it later on the settings screen.

Session.description: Who is signed in to a panel, and the shop the request worked in. On the owner's panel: the login from config.php and the shop the request named (`X-Shop`). On an agent's panel: their bot and its shop.

name.description: The owner's login, or the agent's bot (@username). Their decisions are recorded under this name.

shops.description: Every shop the owner may open, the main bot's first.

ShopRef.description: A bot's shop: the main bot's, or an agent's.

id.description: The bot's id; 1 is the main bot.

name.description: «فروشگاه اصلی» for the main bot; an agent's bot's title, or «نماینده: » and the agent's name while the agent has not connected a bot yet.

plans.description: The plans, their categories and their server entries.

referrals.description: Referral commissions, bonuses, rewards and alerts.

agency.description: The agency's levels and requests, the agents' bots and their traffic.

channels.description: The channels a customer must join.

reports.description: The report group, its topics and its queue.

emoji.description: The premium emoji the bot has seen.

tickets.description: The support tickets and their messages.

reviews.description: The customers' reviews of the shop.

rewards.description: Gift codes, the lucky wheel's slices and spins, loyalty tiers, cashback rules, and the nightly draws with their winners.

discounts.description: Discount codes and timed sales. A code's use count changes with orders.

ClientErrorRequest.description: An error in the panel's own code, reported by the page. It becomes one error line in the server log (with the app's version) and is stored nowhere else. Each part is truncated and stripped of secrets. A body over 16 KB is a 413; each user or address may send 20 reports in ten minutes and 100 a day (then a 429 with `Retry-After`).

kind.description: `render`: a page failed to render (an error boundary or the router's error screen). `unhandled`: an error from a click handler or a promise that nothing handled.

stack.description: The top of the error's stack.

component_stack.description: For a render failure: the React component stack.

address.description: The panel address where it happened: its path and query, never the fragment (which may hold a sign-in code).

build.description: The panel build: when `vite build` made it.

QueueCounts.description: What waits for support: the sidebar's counts, and the first rows of the dashboard's attention card.

stuck_orders.description: Paid orders not delivered because the delivery failed or stalled (the orders list's `stuck` tab).

open_tickets.description: Support tickets waiting for an answer (the tickets list's `open` tab).

pending_reviews.description: Reviews waiting for approval (the reviews list's `pending` tab).

UserRole.description: `admin`: a bot admin. They can use /broadcast, are exempt from the bot's gates, and can use the website's admin API while the website lets admins in. Unrelated to the panel login.

UserRow.description: A customer, as a row of the users table. (The panel login is not a customer.)

name.description: "first last" from Telegram, or as they signed up with; null when the account has none.

username.description: Telegram handle without "@"; null when the account has none.

telegram_id.description: Their Telegram user id; null for a customer who signed up on the website (the bot cannot message them).

email.description: Their verified email, in lower case; null when they have none.

phone.description: In E.164 form, once shared with the bot.

discount_percent.description: Their personal discount («تخفیف اختصاصی»): a percent off what they buy for themselves. It is one of the automatic discounts, of which the largest applies. 0 for none.

groups.description: The customer groups they are in, in the groups' order.

UserSort.description: The users table's sort keys: sign-up time (the default), last seen, balance (no ledger counts as 0), orders, active services.

UserDetailResponse.description: One customer, as their page shows them. Their services, orders and payments come from those lists, filtered with `user=`.

agency.description: The customer as an agent of the main bot, as the agents list shows them (level and credit, their bot and its sales); null for anyone who is not an agent, and always in an agent's shop.

CustomerAccount.description: The customer's website account, as support sees it: how they sign in, whether password sign-in has a second step, the signed-in devices, and the accounts merged into it.

email.description: Their verified email; null without one.

google.description: They can sign in with a Google account.

has_password.description: They can sign in with their email and a password.

two_factor.description: Password sign-in also asks for their authenticator app's code.

sessions.description: The number of devices signed in on the website (sessions not ended).

merges.description: The accounts merged into this one, newest first.

CustomerMerge.description: An account merged into this customer's account (its row no longer exists): how it signed in, its name, and when the customer merged them. Accounts are only merged by the customer, from the website.

telegram_id.description: Its Telegram user id; null for none.

google.description: It could sign in with a Google account.

name.description: Its "first last" name; null without one.

UserRoleRequest.description: Make a customer a bot admin, or take the role back.

UserDiscountRequest.description: A customer's personal discount («تخفیف اختصاصی»), until changed: a percent off everything they buy for themselves.

UserGroupsRequest.description: The customer's groups: exactly the ones listed. An empty list removes them from all groups.

CustomerReferral.description: A customer's referral details: who referred them, how many customers they referred, and what that earned them.

referrer.description: The customer whose link brought them; null if none.

referrals.description: How many customers their link brought.

earned.description: The total of the commissions credited to them, in Toman. A commission stays with whoever earned it, even if accounts were merged since.

CustomerGroupRef.description: A customer group, as a customer's row lists it.

CustomerGroupRow.description: A customer group («گروه»), in the admin's order. A broadcast can target one.

agent_pricing.description: Its members pay the plans' agent prices («قیمت نماینده»), as agents do (a «همکار» group).

CustomerGroupRequest.description: A customer group to add or update.

name.description: Unique within the shop.

agent_pricing.description: Its members pay the plans' agent prices. Left out: off for a new group, unchanged for an existing one.

WalletTransactionRow.description: One line of a customer's wallet ledger.

counterpart.description: A wallet transfer's line («انتقال موجودی»): the other customer — whom the money went to (a debit) or came from (a credit). Null for every other line.

reviewer.description: Who added the line by hand: a panel user or a website admin. Anyone but the owner sees the owner's login as «پشتیبانی». Null for lines the shop wrote automatically.

WalletAdjustmentRequest.description: A manual credit or debit, with the line the customer sees in their ledger. A debit cannot exceed the balance.

description.description: The ledger line, at most 190 characters. Blank for the default wording.

revenue.description: Money received, in Toman: paid payments not made from the wallet, plus refunded ones except wallet top-ups.

active_subscriptions.description: Active services, free test accounts aside.

stuck_orders.description: Paid orders not delivered because the delivery failed or stalled (the orders list's `stuck` tab).

open_tickets.description: Support tickets waiting for an answer (the tickets list's `open` tab).

pending_reviews.description: Reviews waiting for approval (the reviews list's `pending` tab).

servers_with_errors.description: Servers whose panel failed its last check. Always 0 in an agent's shop.

expiring_soon.description: Active services ending within `expiring_days`, free test accounts aside.

traffic_shortage.description: Set when an agent's shop has too little traffic to sell anything; null otherwise, and always null in the main shop.

agency_standing.description: An agent's shop's terms of selling with the main shop (its end, its monthly minimum, a suspension), for the owner's panel and the agent's; always null in the main shop, and for the shop's admins on its website (`/admin/dashboard`).

expiring_days.description: The "ending soon" window in days, the same as on the subscriptions screen.

OrderPricing.description: Which price a purchase or renewal was made at: `regular`, the plan's price (also used for every other order type); `first_purchase`, its first-purchase price («قیمت خرید اول», for a customer who had bought no service); `agent`, its agent price («قیمت نماینده», for an agent or a member of a group with agent prices); or `gift`, free (a prize, or a service from a gift code or referral reward).

OrderType.description: What an order buys: a plan (`purchase`), a service's `renewal`, a `wallet_topup`, `traffic` for an agent's bot (main bot only), or `extra_traffic`, `extra_time` or `extra_devices` for an existing service.

plan.description: Its plan's name — a service the customer built in words, «سرویس دلخواه · ۵۰ گیگ · ۳۰ روز» —; null for an order of neither.

name.description: "first last" from Telegram, or as they signed up with; null when the account has none.

username.description: Telegram handle without "@"; null when the account has none.

telegram_id.description: Their Telegram user id; null for a customer who signed up on the website (the bot cannot message them).

email.description: Their verified email, in lower case; null when they have none.

BotRuntime.description: How a bot runs. The main bot's mode applies to the whole installation: every bot gets updates the same way (all on webhooks, or all polling), and the main bot's token is in config.php.

enabled.description: The shop's master switch (bot settings), whether or not the process is running.

username.description: Its username, without the @; null while unknown.

BotMode.description: How a bot gets its updates: `webhook` (Telegram calls it), `polling` (a `bot:poll` process with a fresh heartbeat), or `offline` (neither).

SystemStatus.description: The system's health: the version, PHP, the bots and the scheduler. Owner only.

bot.description: The bot of the shop the request names (the dashboard's shop): the main bot or an agent's.

id.description: The bot's id; 1 is the main bot.

enabled.description: The shop's master switch (bot settings), whether or not the process is running.

username.description: Its username, without the @; null while unknown.

WebhookOutcome.description: The result of setting or deleting the webhook for one bot. The message never contains a token or the webhook address's secret.

id.description: The bot's id; 1 is the main bot.

username.description: Its username, without the @; null while unknown.

message.description: What happened, or why it failed.

bots.description: Every running bot, the main one first. Empty while no bot has a token.

UpdateStatus.description: AmoBot's update status: the running version, the newest release on GitHub, and the current or last update. Only releases signed with the release key built into the app are installed.

latest.description: The newest release, as last read; null when GitHub has none, or before the first check.

checked_at.description: When GitHub was last checked; null before the first check.

available.description: The newest release is newer than the running version, and no update is running or has just installed it.

blocker.description: Why the shop cannot update itself (no release key, PHP without the sodium or zip extension, PHP not allowed to change the app's files, or a release without its signed files), with the alternative: a manual update (docs/Upgrading.md). Null when nothing blocks it.

run.description: The current or last update; null when there is none.

ReleaseInfo.description: A release as GitHub lists it.

version.description: Its version (the tag without the v).

notes.description: Its release notes as plain text, line breaks kept. Never render them as HTML.

UpdateStep.description: An update's step: `download` (fetch and verify the files), `extract` (unpack), `preflight` (check the host), `install`, then `done`, or `rolled_back` after a rollback. A failed install is rolled back automatically and stays at `install` with its error.

from.description: The version running when it started; a rollback restores it.

progress.description: Progress of the current step, in percent.

error.description: Why the step last failed; null when nothing is wrong.

cancel.description: It can still be cancelled: none of the app's files were replaced yet.

rollback.description: It can be rolled back: it is installed, the replaced version is kept, and it did not change the database.

finished_at.description: When it was installed or rolled back; null while running.

version.description: The newest release (`latest.version`). Updating to any other version is refused.

GatewayKind.description: How a gateway settles: `instant` (at once, like the wallet), or `manual` (once a person, or the method's automatic approval window, accepts the receipt of a card transfer).

PaymentRow.description: A payment, as a row of the payments screen.

gateway.description: Driver key ("manual", "wallet", or "outside": money support took outside the shop for an order it made).

kind.description: How the driver settles; null when the driver is no longer installed.

method.description: The payment method's label ("کارت به کارت (ملت)"). A method with payments is never deleted.

summary.description: What the customer was told to pay to: a card transfer's card, the one of its method's cards it was shown («6037 •••• •••• 1119 · holder · bank») — or «کارت در پیوی پشتیبانی داده شد» for one shown none, taken in support's private chat (`BotSettingsData.card_to_support`); null for a method without one (the wallet).

reference.description: The gateway's own id for the payment (the wallet's ledger line); null when it has none (a card transfer).

description.description: The note on its latest decision: why it failed or was cancelled (the admin's reason or note, the gateway's refusal, the order paid another way or left unpaid, or its service handed to another customer: «سرویس این سفارش به حساب دیگری منتقل شد»), or a refund's note (also in `refund_note`).

plan.description: What it buys in words, as `OrderPackageName`: its plan's name (an extra's: its service's plan's), or a service the customer built as «سرویس دلخواه · ۵۰ گیگ · ۳۰ روز»; null for any other order.

traffic_bytes.description: The traffic it adds, in bytes: an agent's traffic, a service's extra traffic, or a built service's traffic; null otherwise.

days.description: The days it adds to a service (extra time), or a built service's term; null otherwise.

devices.description: The devices it adds to a service's IP limit (extra devices), or a built service's limit; null otherwise.

notes.description: Why its delivery failed; null unless it did. The owner sees the panel's full diagnosis, anyone else a short summary.

discount_amount.description: The total its discounts took off (the automatic one and the code's), in Toman; 0 for none.

discounts.description: The discounts applied, the automatic one first.

discount_code.description: The discount code used; it counts as one of the code's uses unless the order is cancelled. Null for none.

receipt.description: The customer's receipt, always a picture: sent in the bot (which accepts only pictures) or uploaded on the website. Null until sent. `GET …/receipt` serves either.

reviewer.description: Who decided it by hand: the agent's @bot, a bot admin's @username, tg:<id> or user#<id> (in the report group or on the website), or the owner's login, which anyone but the owner sees as «پشتیبانی».

actions.description: Which operations its current state allows (the server decides).

PaymentSort.description: The payments list's sort keys: creation time (the default) or amount.

awaiting_review.description: Receipts waiting for review, regardless of the filters.

paid.description: How many of the listed payments (tab, search and dates) are paid.

Delivery.description: What happened to a notice the bot sent a customer: `told` (delivered in Telegram); `emailed` (Telegram could not reach them, because they have no Telegram account or blocked the bot, so it was emailed); `turned_away` (they blocked the bot or their account is gone, and no email went); `unreachable` (Telegram, or the mail server for an email, could not be reached); `refused` (Telegram refused it); `no_telegram` (no Telegram account and no email went, so nothing was sent). Either way the notice is kept for their website.

DismissReceiptsRequest.description: Which receipts waiting for review to reject: the payments `ids` names, or `all` of them. One of the two; with `note`, support's note to each customer (at most 300 characters; blank for none).

ids.description: Payment ids, at most 100. Those no longer waiting for review are skipped.

all.description: True for every receipt waiting for review that had come by `until`, the oldest first — at most 100 a request (`left` says how many of them still wait).

until.description: With `all`: the previous answer's `until`, so the next round takes no receipt sent since the first began. Left out, now; never later than now.

skipped.description: How many named were not: no longer waiting for review (decided meanwhile), or not found.

left.description: How many receipts still wait for review in the shop — with `all`, of those that had come by `until`.

until.description: With `all`: the moment the run is held to — send it back with the next round. Null for `ids`.

OrderRow.description: An order, as a row of the orders screen: what the customer asked for, and how far it got.

discount_amount.description: The total its discounts took off (the automatic one and the code's), in Toman; 0 for none.

discounts.description: The discounts applied, the automatic one first.

discount_code.description: The discount code used; it counts as one of the code's uses unless the order is cancelled. Null for none.

plan.description: The plan of a purchase or renewal; for extras, the service's plan.

renewal_method.description: How a renewal adds its package (a renewal from before renewal methods, `extend`); null for any other order.

server.description: The server the customer chose; for a renewal or extras, the service's server.

subscription.description: The service it bought, renewed or extended; null for a top-up, or once the service was deleted.

traffic_bytes.description: The traffic it adds, in bytes: an agent's traffic, a service's extra traffic, or a built service's traffic; null otherwise.

days.description: The days it adds to a service (extra time), or a built service's term; null otherwise.

devices.description: The devices it adds to a service's IP limit (extra devices), or a built service's limit; null otherwise.

notes.description: Why it failed or was cancelled. For a failed delivery, the owner sees the panel's full diagnosis; anyone else (an agent, a website admin) a short summary.

manual.description: An order support made by hand for the customer (`POST /users/{id}/orders`): who, how it was paid and their note. Null for an order the customer made.

NamedRef.description: A reference by id and name (a plan, a server).

gateway.description: Driver key ("manual", "wallet", or "outside": money support took outside the shop for an order it made).

method.description: The payment method's label. A method with payments is never deleted.

OrderSort.description: The orders list's sort keys: creation time (the default) or amount.

stuck.description: Stuck orders (paid but not delivered), regardless of the filters.

sold.description: How many of the listed orders (tab, type, search and dates) are sales: paid, being delivered or delivered.

ManualPayment.description: How an order support makes by hand is paid: `free` (a gift: no price, no purchase of the customer's), `wallet` (support's amount charged to the customer's wallet) or `outside` (support's amount taken outside the shop, cash or another card: the shop's takings).

OrderManual.description: An order support made by hand for its customer.

by.description: Who made it: the panel login, or an admin's @username / tg:<id> (the owner's login reads «پشتیبانی» to anyone but the owner).

note.description: Support's note on it; null for none.

ManualOrderRequest.description: An order support makes for a customer by hand: a plan (`plan_id`), or — without one — a service of support's own numbers (`traffic_gb`, `days`, `devices`, each required then), on `server_id`, paid as `payment` says.

plan_id.description: A plan of the shop, switched on or off; left out or null for support's own numbers.

traffic_gb.description: Whole gigabytes, 0 (unlimited) to 10000. Not in an agent's shop: 0, or more than the agent has left.

days.description: Whole days from the first connection, 0 (never ends) to 365.

server_id.description: The server: one of the plan's that can deliver it now, or for support's own numbers any that can take a client now.

client_name.description: The service's name on its panel («نام کاربری سرویس»): 3 to 32 Latin letters, digits, `_` and `-`, one the server's panel takes and no service there has. Blank for the shop's pattern.

amount.description: Whole Toman above zero, at most 100,000,000, for `wallet` and `outside`; ignored for `free`.

note.description: Support's note, kept on the order and said in the report group; at most 300 characters.

subscription.description: The service it made; null while its delivery failed.

SubscriptionRow.description: A service, as a row of the subscriptions screen: a client on a panel, as last read from it.

name.description: The client's name on the panel ("amir_2", "USER_7").

is_test.description: A free test account («اکانت تست»): no plan, never renewed, never counted as ending soon (`expiring_soon`); removed by the tests' own rule (`removes_at`).

claimed_at.description: When the customer added it by sending its link («افزودن سرویس با لینک», `claim_enabled`): a client made by hand on its panel. Null for any other service. Such a service has no plan until a renewal on one the customer picks, sold on its server (a renewal with a package built leaves it without).

plan.description: Null for a service without a plan — a test account, a service added by its link (`claimed_at`) or built by the customer («سرویس دلخواه»), until a renewal on a plan; one renewed with a package built stays so — and once the plan is deleted.

traffic.description: In bytes; a limit of 0 means unlimited.

ip_limit.description: Devices allowed at once; 0 means unlimited.

duration_days.description: The term in whole days, rounded up; 0 only when it never expires. `duration_hours` is exact.

duration_hours.description: The term in hours, counted from the first connection; 0 never expires.

auto_renew.description: The customer's auto-renewal («تمدید خودکار»): renewed from their wallet before the deadline.

next_period.description: A renewal queued after the current period (unused traffic of the current period is not carried over): when it starts, and the most traffic left then, in bytes. Null while no traffic cap waits for it — a renewal may still have queued its device limit alone (`next_devices`).

next_devices.description: A renewal's device limit queued after the current period: a running service renewed by `extend` or `reset_traffic` keeps the devices it has (extra devices bought included) until the period in use ends, and has the renewal's from then. Null while the limit stays as `ip_limit` says.

starts_at.description: When the first connection started the term; null until then.

expires_at.description: Null while waiting for the first connection, or without a term.

expiring_soon.description: Active, no free test account, and ending within the list's `meta.expiring_days`.

last_synced_at.description: When the panel was last read for it; the numbers are from then.

ended_at.description: When it ended: the deadline it passed, or when the shop found its traffic used up or its client gone from the panel. Null while it runs, and past a deadline until the shop next reads its panel.

removes_at.description: When the shop removes it from its panel and the shop by itself, by its rules now: `expired_cleanup_hours` after it ended while `expired_cleanup` is on; a test, while `test_cleanup` is on, `test_cleanup_hours` after it ended — or, never connected, `test_unused_days` after it was made. Null when no rule removes it: it runs (a test never connected aside), it is switched off, or the rule is off. A moment already past: it goes at the next check (every 15 minutes), unless an order of it is still open.

actions.description: Which operations its current state allows (the server decides).

transfer.description: Handing it to another customer («انتقال سرویس»): anything but a free test account or a service gone from its panel.

extend.description: Adding days and traffic: for an active service with an end date or a quota.

SubscriptionExtensionRequest.description: Days and traffic to add to one service («افزایش زمان و حجم»), as a grant adds them. At least one amount must be above zero; days only for a service with an end date, traffic only for one with a quota. In an agent's shop the traffic is taken from the agent's bot (refused on `traffic_gb` when it is short); days cost nothing.

days.description: Whole days, 0 to 365; blank for none.

note.description: Support's note to the customer, a separate line of the message; at most 300 characters.

notify.description: Whether to notify the customer; default true.

SubscriptionMoveRequest.description: Move an active service to another server, keeping its remaining days and traffic. `leave_previous` moves it without contacting the previous panel (when it is unreachable); the old client stays there until that panel answers again, then it is removed by itself (the owner's server page lists it meanwhile). In an agent's shop this is allowed only while that panel is unreachable.

SubscriptionDeleteRequest.description: Delete a service from its panel and from the shop, permanently. The customer is notified only if the service was still active; the note goes with that message. `leave_panel` deletes it without contacting the panel (when it is unreachable); the client stays there. In an agent's shop this is allowed only while that panel is unreachable; the owner in the main shop may always (not the website's admins, who need the panel out of reach as any other shop's), which is how a service added by its link to the wrong customer (`SubscriptionRow.claimed_at`) is taken back for the right one to send its link again.

SubscriptionTransferRequest.description: «انتقال سرویس»: whom to hand the service to — a customer of the shop, by their numeric Telegram id; they must have started the bot once.

telegram_id.description: Their numeric Telegram id: a number, or its digits as typed.

SubscriptionKind.description: The services list's `kind` filter: the free test accounts (`test`), the services customers added by their link (`claimed`, «افزودن سرویس با لینک»: `SubscriptionRow.claimed_at` set), or every other service — sold, renewed or given (`regular`: neither a test nor a claimed one).

SubscriptionSort.description: The services list's sort keys: creation time (the default), end date (services that never end or have not started come after every deadline), or traffic used.

meta.description: `expiring` counts active services ending within `expiring_days`, free test accounts aside (the tab's count; the dashboard uses the same window).

TicketStatus.description: A ticket's status: `open` (waiting for support), `answered` (support wrote last; waiting for the customer) or `closed`. A customer's message makes it open (reopening a closed one); support's answer makes it answered. Either side can close it; support can reopen it.

TicketAuthor.description: Who wrote a ticket message: the customer or support.

TicketChannel.description: Where a ticket message was written. The customer writes on the website (`web`) or in the bot (`bot`); support in a panel (`panel`), the website's admin API (`staff`) or the report group (`group`).

TicketAttachment.description: A message's picture. Its bytes are at the message's attachment address (`…/messages/{message}/attachment`).

name.description: Its file name, from the sender's device or generated.

kept.description: Whether the file is still stored. Uploaded pictures are deleted 30 days after the ticket closes (reopening keeps the pictures still there; deleted ones do not come back). When false, the message still shows it had a picture, and its address is a 404.

TicketRow.description: A support ticket, as the list shows it.

subscription.description: The customer's service it is about, by its panel name; null for none, or when the service was deleted.

last_message_at.description: When its latest message was written; the list is sorted by it.

rating.description: The customer's rating after it closed, 1 to 5; null for none.

closed_at.description: When it was closed; null while open (reopening clears it).

reviewer.description: Which support person wrote it: a panel user, or a bot admin's @username, tg:<id> or user#<id> (in the report group or on the website). Anyone but the owner sees the owner's login as «پشتیبانی». Null for the customer's messages.

TicketDetail.description: A support ticket with its whole conversation, oldest message first.

subscription.description: The customer's service it is about, by its panel name; null for none, or when the service was deleted.

last_message_at.description: When its latest message was written; the list is sorted by it.

rating.description: The customer's rating after it closed, 1 to 5; null for none.

closed_at.description: When it was closed; null while open (reopening clears it).

rating_note.description: The note the customer left with their rating.

open.description: Tickets waiting for an answer, regardless of the filters.

TicketMessageRequest.description: A ticket message's text: support's answer on a panel, or the customer's message on the website. To attach a picture, send a form instead (TicketMessageUploadRequest).

body.description: 1 to 4000 characters; line breaks are kept.

TicketMessageUploadRequest.description: A ticket message with a picture, as a browser form uploads it. A form without a file is a message without a picture.

body.description: 1 to 4000 characters; line breaks are kept.

file.description: The picture: a JPEG, PNG or WebP (checked by its content), at most 10 MB. Optional.

ReviewStatus.description: A review's status: `pending` (waiting for support), `approved` (shown on the website) or `rejected` (kept but not shown). Support can change it either way at any time.

ReviewRow.description: A review written on the website, as the moderation screen lists it.

name.description: The name it is signed with.

body.description: Its text, with line breaks as written.

context.description: A line on where the service is used («ایرانسل · اندروید · Happ»); null for none.

customer.description: The signed-in customer who wrote it; null for a guest, or when the account is gone.

reviewer.description: Who last approved or rejected it: a panel user, or a website admin (@username, tg:<id> or user#<id>). Anyone but the owner sees the owner's login as «پشتیبانی». Null while pending.

decided_at.description: When it was last approved or rejected; null while pending.

actions.description: Which decisions its status allows (deleting is always allowed).

pending.description: Reviews waiting for support, regardless of the filters.

ServerDriversResponse.description: The panel connectors a server can use, in order. Each has its description and required versions (`notes`), what the add-server picker shows (`traits`: `mark`, two letters; `vendor`; `docs_url`), what its panels support (`inbounds`, `link_rotation`), and the whole server form for it: the name, the connector's connection fields, then the server's own fields.

form.description: The server's stored form values, with the fields its connector lists (ServerDriversResponse): how the shop signs in to the panel (`auth_mode`, and each secret as a SecretState that says whether one is stored, never the secret), the connection options, and the server's own fields. Null when this installation does not have its connector.

serves_subscriptions.description: Whether the panel served subscription links at the last check; null if never checked. A server without them cannot be sold.

first_purchase_price.description: The price of a customer's first purchase in the shop («قیمت خرید اول»), whole Toman below `price`; 0 makes it free. Blank or null for none. Left out: none for a new plan, unchanged for an existing one.

agent_price.description: The price for agents and members of groups with agent prices («قیمت نماینده»), whole Toman below `price`. Blank or null for none. Left out: none for a new plan, unchanged for an existing one.

checkout_note.description: A note shown under the bot's checkout for this plan, at most 500 characters. Blank or null for none. Left out: none for a new plan, unchanged for an existing one.

button_style.description: The colour of its button in the bot's plan list: blue, green or red. Blank or null for the client's default. Left out: the default for a new plan, unchanged for an existing one.

button_row.description: How many buttons share its row there, 1 to 3. Left out: a row of its own for a new plan, unchanged for an existing one.

extras.description: The plan's own prices for extra traffic, time and devices; null to use the shop's. Left out: the shop's for a new plan, unchanged for an existing one.

category_id.description: A category id (`PlanCategoryRow.id`); blank or 0 for none.

servers.description: At least one, each server once.

is_active.description: Left out: on for a new plan, unchanged for an existing one.

PlanPricesRequest.description: A bulk change of several plans' prices: raise or lower the named prices by a percent or a number of Toman, rounding each new price to the nearest step. A plan without one of the named prices still has none afterwards.

plan_ids.description: The plans to change; at least one.

mode.description: A percent of each price (at most 1000, or 100 for a decrease), or a number of Toman.

value.description: The percent (decimals allowed) or whole Toman; above zero.

round_to.description: Each new price is rounded to the nearest multiple of this; 1 means whole Toman.

prices.description: Which prices change: the price, the first-purchase price, the agent price.

changes.description: Every plan named, in the plans list's order.

problem.description: Why the plan cannot take the change: a price below zero or above the maximum, or a first-purchase or agent price no longer below the price. Null when it can.

PlanServerEntryInput.description: A server the plan is sold on: the whole server (every inbound marked sellable at purchase time) or the picked inbounds. A connector without inbounds always sells the whole server.

all_inbounds.description: Left out: only the picked inbounds.

inbound_ids.description: Enabled inbounds of this server (`PlanInboundRef.id`); empty for the whole server.

PlanCategoryRequest.description: A plan category to add or update.

name.description: Unique in the shop.

is_active.description: Left out: on for a new category, unchanged for an existing one.

PaymentDriversResponse.description: The gateway drivers a payment method can use, in registration order. Each has its form (the method's settings) and its traits: `kind`, how it settles (a GatewayKind), and `builtin`, part of every shop (the wallet: one row per shop, never added or deleted, with no settings).

PaymentMethodRow.description: A payment method, in checkout order, as its driver describes it. `config` holds the driver's form values as stored (one closed shape per driver). Never «خارج از فروشگاه», support's alone.

label.description: The button text customers see, such as "کارت به کارت (ملت)".

summary.description: The driver's one-line summary of the method from its settings; null when it has none (the wallet; a card method, whose cards are listed under `cards`).

min_amount.description: The least amount to pay it is offered for, in Toman; null for no least. Checkouts of less do not offer it.

max_amount.description: The most amount to pay it is offered for, in Toman; null for no most.

payments.description: The number of payments made with it. A method with payments cannot be deleted.

ManualMethodRow.description: A card-to-card method, with its cards: each payment is shown one of them at random, among those switched on whose daily cap leaves room for its amount, and always that one after — none while `to_support`.

label.description: The button text customers see, such as "کارت به کارت (ملت)".

summary.description: The driver's one-line summary of the method from its settings; null when it has none (the wallet; a card method, whose cards are listed under `cards`).

min_amount.description: The least amount to pay it is offered for, in Toman; null for no least. Checkouts of less do not offer it.

max_amount.description: The most amount to pay it is offered for, in Toman; null for no most.

payments.description: The number of payments made with it. A method with payments cannot be deleted.

cards.description: In their order. None switched on with room left: the method is not offered — unless `to_support`.

to_support.description: The shop takes card payments in support's private chat now (`BotSettingsData.card_to_support`, with a support contact): no card is shown nor picked, so the cards' switches and daily caps do not hold the method back.

UnregisteredMethodRow.description: A method whose driver is no longer installed. No checkout offers it, even when switched on; it can only be switched off or deleted.

label.description: The button text customers see, such as "کارت به کارت (ملت)".

summary.description: The driver's one-line summary of the method from its settings; null when it has none (the wallet; a card method, whose cards are listed under `cards`).

config.description: Not shown, since without the driver it is unknown which settings are secrets.

min_amount.description: The least amount to pay it is offered for, in Toman; null for no least. Checkouts of less do not offer it.

max_amount.description: The most amount to pay it is offered for, in Toman; null for no most.

payments.description: The number of payments made with it. A method with payments cannot be deleted.

ManualGatewayConfig.description: A card-to-card method's settings (`ManualMethodRow.config`): the manual driver's form values as stored. A field added after the method was saved shows its default. Its cards are rows of their own (`ManualMethodRow.cards`).

auto_approve_after.description: Minutes a receipt sent in the bot may wait for review before it is approved automatically; 0 for manual approval only.

PaymentCardRow.description: A card of a card-to-card method.

bank.description: The owner's word for it, such as its bank; null for none.

summary.description: Which card, in one line as lists and reports name it: its first and last four digits, its holder and its bank, apart with « · », such as "6037 •••• •••• 1119 · امیر رضایی · ملت".

enabled.description: Off: no new payment is shown it; a payment shown it before still is.

daily_cap.description: The most it takes in a day on the shop's clock, in Toman; null for no cap.

today.description: What came to it today on the shop's clock: its payments made today that are paid, refunded or still open.

payments.description: The payments shown it. A card with payments keeps its number and is never deleted (switch it off).

PaymentCardInput.description: A card in a card-to-card method's form: a card of the method kept by its `id`, a new one without.

id.description: A card of this method, kept; left out or null for a new one.

number.description: 16 digits passing the check digit; Persian digits, and spaces or dashes between them, are accepted. A card with payments keeps its number.

holder.description: Whose card it is, as the bank shows it; at most 100 characters.

bank.description: Its bank, or any word for it; at most 60 characters, blank or null for none.

daily_cap.description: Whole Toman a day on the shop's clock; blank or null for no cap.

ManualMethodRequest.description: A card-to-card method's form: the label customers pick it by, its switch, the amounts it is offered for, the manual driver's form (the note under the card, and how long a receipt may wait for review) and its cards.

label.description: The checkout button's text, such as «کارت به کارت (ملت)». Left out on an update: unchanged.

enabled.description: Left out: on for a new method, unchanged for an existing one.

min_amount.description: The least amount to pay it is offered for: whole Toman, blank or null for no least. Left out on an update: unchanged.

max_amount.description: The most amount to pay it is offered for (not less than `min_amount`): whole Toman, blank or null for no most. Left out on an update: unchanged.

instructions.description: Shown to the customer with the card; blank for none.

auto_approve_after.description: Minutes a receipt sent in the bot may wait for review before it is approved automatically; blank or 0 for manual approval only.

cards.description: Every card of the method, 1 to 20, in their order, each once: a card left out is deleted — one with payments cannot be (switch it off) —, and no number comes twice. Every refusal is under `cards`, each naming its card by its place («کارت ۲: …»).

WalletMethodRequest.description: The wallet, the built-in method: its label, its switch and the amounts it is offered for.

min_amount.description: The least amount to pay it is offered for: whole Toman, blank or null for no least. Left out on an update: unchanged.

max_amount.description: The most amount to pay it is offered for (not less than `min_amount`): whole Toman, blank or null for no most. Left out on an update: unchanged.

ManualMethodCreateRequest.description: A new card-to-card method: its driver and its form (ManualMethodRequest), with the label required.

label.description: The checkout button's text, such as «کارت به کارت (ملت)». Left out on an update: unchanged.

enabled.description: Left out: on for a new method, unchanged for an existing one.

min_amount.description: The least amount to pay it is offered for: whole Toman, blank or null for no least. Left out on an update: unchanged.

max_amount.description: The most amount to pay it is offered for (not less than `min_amount`): whole Toman, blank or null for no most. Left out on an update: unchanged.

instructions.description: Shown to the customer with the card; blank for none.

auto_approve_after.description: Minutes a receipt sent in the bot may wait for review before it is approved automatically; blank or 0 for manual approval only.

cards.description: Every card of the method, 1 to 20, in their order, each once: a card left out is deleted — one with payments cannot be (switch it off) —, and no number comes twice. Every refusal is under `cards`, each naming its card by its place («کارت ۲: …»).

PaymentMethodCreateRequest.description: A new payment method for a driver that is not built in: the driver's key, the label customers pick it by, the switch and the driver's form (`DriverDescription.fields`). One closed shape per driver, checked against its form by tests/Unit/Drivers/DriverFormsTest.

PaymentMethodUpdateRequest.description: A payment method's form, as its driver takes it. One closed shape per driver, checked against its form by tests/Unit/Drivers/DriverFormsTest. A method whose driver is no longer installed cannot be updated (switch it off or delete it).

PaymentMethodSwitchRequest.description: A payment method's on/off switch. A JSON boolean only.

ButtonStyle.description: Telegram's button colours (`style` on KeyboardButton and InlineKeyboardButton). Null means the client's default look.

label.description: The button text; on a reply keyboard, also what a tap sends.

icon.description: A premium emoji's id (see CustomEmojiRow), shown before the label (Telegram's `icon_custom_emoji_id`). It shows only while the bot's owner has Telegram Premium. Null for none.

KeyboardLayoutData.description: One of the bot's keyboards as laid out. Rows are in reading order (the first button is the rightmost).

KeyboardAction.description: An action a menu button can trigger.

screen.description: The `menu:*` callback data an inline button carries.

actions.description: The actions this shop's menu buttons can have. An agent's bot has no «نمایندگی»: its layouts never show it, and saving it is refused.

KeyboardRequest.description: A new keyboard layout: its type and its rows in reading order (the first button is the rightmost). Empty rows are dropped.

KeyboardButtonInput.description: A button as the editor sends it (a KeyboardButtonSpec). Each action and each label may appear only once per keyboard.

label.description: Plain text; a premium emoji goes in `icon`.

icon.description: A premium emoji's id; null for none.

BotTextKind.description: Where a text is used: a `message` or the QR card's `caption` (Telegram HTML), a callback `popup` or a `button` (plain text), or a `part` included in other texts.

BotTextVariable.description: A `%name%` placeholder the bot fills in when it sends the text.

sample.description: The sample value the screen's preview uses.

required.description: The wording must contain it (a delivery message needs its link).

BotTextRow.description: A text the bot sends customers, with its default wording and the current one.

html.description: Telegram reads it as HTML (a message, a caption or a part).

limit.description: The maximum length of the wording, in characters.

value.description: The wording in use: the custom one, or the default.

groups.description: The text groups of the shop's bot, in the screen's order. An agent's bot has no «نمایندگی» group.

BotTextRequest.description: A new wording: Telegram HTML for a message, a caption or a part, plain text for a popup or a button, with all its required variables. Sending the default wording restores the default.

CustomEmojiRow.description: A premium emoji an admin sent the bot with /emoji, offered by the bot texts and keyboards editors.

id.description: Telegram's custom emoji id: digits, as a string.

emoji.description: The plain emoji it stands for, which goes inside its <tg-emoji> tag.

format.description: How Telegram draws it: a still picture, a Lottie animation or a WebM video (see `…/animation`); null while unknown.

repaint.description: Telegram paints it in the colour of the surrounding text (`needs_repainting`).

status.description: Whether the bot can send premium emoji, as the last /emoji check found; null before the first check.

GiftCodeKind.description: What a gift code gives: Toman in the wallet, or a free service of a plan.

GiftCodeStatus.description: A gift code's status: `unused`, `redeemed` by a customer, or `expired` without being redeemed.

GiftCodeRow.description: A gift code («کد هدیه»), redeemable once by one customer of the shop.

code.description: Upper-case Latin letters and digits, as stored and matched. Customers may type it in any case, with dashes and spaces.

amount.description: Toman, for the wallet; null for a plan.

plan.description: The plan it gives; null for a Toman code, or when the plan was deleted (then nobody can redeem it).

expires_at.description: When it expires (the first moment it can no longer be redeemed); null for never.

redeemed_by.description: Who redeemed it; null while unredeemed, or once their account is gone.

order.description: For a redeemed plan code: the order that delivered its service.

GiftCodeBatchRequest.description: A batch of gift codes to create. Every refusal is returned at once, under its field.

amount.description: For `wallet` codes (required): whole Toman each code adds to the wallet, 1,000 to 500,000,000.

plan_id.description: For `plan` codes (required): the plan whose service each code gives. Any plan of the shop, even one that is switched off.

batch.description: The batch label (at most 64 characters). A batch is listed, copied and deleted by its label.

prefix.description: A prefix for every code: Latin letters and digits, at most 12 (dashes and spaces are dropped, letters upper-cased). Blank for none.

expires_on.description: The last day the codes can be redeemed, in the shop's time zone (YYYY-MM-DD, today or later). Blank or left out: never expires.

created_at.description: When its newest codes were created.

WheelPrizeKind.description: What a lucky wheel slice gives: `nothing` («پوچ»), Toman in the wallet (`wallet`), GB of `traffic` or `days` on one of the customer's running services, or a free service of a `plan`.

WheelPrizeRow.description: A lucky wheel («گردونه شانس») slice. Its chance is its weight divided by the total weight of the enabled slices the customer can receive at the moment of the spin.

amount.description: Toman (wallet), GB (traffic) or days (days); null for nothing and plan.

plan.description: For a plan slice: the plan; null once the plan is deleted (then nobody can win it).

WheelPrizeRequest.description: A wheel slice to add or update. Every refusal is returned at once, under its field.

label.description: The text the wheel shows, at most 32 characters.

amount.description: For wallet: whole Toman, at least 1,000. For traffic: GB above zero, up to two decimals, at most 10000. For days: whole days, 1 to 3650. Ignored for nothing and plan.

plan_id.description: For a plan slice: the plan whose service it gives.

enabled.description: Left out: on for a new slice, unchanged for an existing one.

WheelSpinRow.description: A lucky wheel spin: the slice it landed on (as the slice was then) and the result.

given.description: The prize was given (for a plan: ordered). False when it could not be: the cost was refunded and the spin does not count for the cooldown.

outcome.description: Why it was not given; null when it was.

order.description: For a plan slice: the order that delivered its service.

subscription.description: The service that got the traffic or days, or the plan's new service.

name.description: The client's name on the panel.

TestAccountState.description: Where a free test account stands: `making` (its panel is still being asked), `waiting` (its hours start at the first connection), `running`, `disabled` (switched off by support), `ended` (its time or traffic ran out, or its panel no longer has it), `removed` (deleted from its panel and the shop; it still counts in the customer's quota).

TestAccountRow.description: A free test account («اکانت تست») the shop gave, with the terms it got (as its server's were then).

server.description: Null once the server is deleted.

on_hold.description: Its hours counted from the first connection; otherwise from the moment it was made.

subscription.description: Its service, as last read from its panel; null while it is being made and once it is removed.

name.description: The client's name on the panel ("test_ali_1").

traffic.description: In bytes; a limit of 0 means unlimited.

starts_at.description: When the first connection started its hours; null until then.

expires_at.description: Null while it waits for the first connection.

bought_after.description: The customer bought a service with a price after taking it.

issued_at.description: When its service was made; null while it is being made.

ended_at.description: When it ended — its deadline, or when the shop found its traffic used up or its client gone (its removal is counted from then); null while it runs (and past its deadline until the shop next reads its panel), and once it is removed.

TestServerRow.description: A server with its test terms (`ServerTestAccount`), and whether it would give a test in this shop now.

test_enabled.description: The server gives free tests (the bot settings switch them on for the shop as a whole).

test_on_hold.description: The hours count from the customer's first connection; otherwise from the moment the test is made.

available.description: The server would give a test in this shop now: it is switched on for tests (`test_enabled`), it can take a client (switched on, serving subscription links, with room, and an inbound it sells where its panel has inbounds), and in an agent's shop the agent's bot has a test's traffic left. The shop's own rules are not counted: its switch (the bot settings' `test_enabled`), the daily cap and each customer's quota. While the shop's switch is off, no customer gets a test, whatever this says.

LoyaltyTierRow.description: A loyalty tier («سطح وفاداری»). A customer is on the highest tier whose `min_spent` they reached; it gives them a discount on purchases and extra cashback on payments.

min_spent.description: Toman a customer must have spent: paid and unrefunded purchases, renewals and extras.

discount_percent.description: 0 to 100; 0 for none. At checkout the largest automatic discount applies (a sale, the personal discount, or this).

cashback_percent.description: 0 to 100; 0 for none. Added to the cashback rules' percent while cashback is on.

customers.description: How many customers are on it now.

LoyaltyTierRequest.description: A loyalty tier to add or update. Every refusal is returned at once, under its field.

name.description: At most 32 characters, unique within the shop.

min_spent.description: Whole Toman, 0 or more; no two tiers may share a threshold. 0 puts every customer on it from the start.

LoyaltyStanding.description: A customer's loyalty standing: their tier, what they spent, and the next tier.

tier.description: Their tier; null when below the first tier, or when the shop has no tiers.

spent.description: Toman spent: paid and unrefunded purchases, renewals and extras.

next.description: The next tier above their spending; null at the top, or when the shop has no tiers.

missing.description: Toman still to spend to reach it.

OwnOrderType.description: An order type a customer buys for themselves — what a discount and a cashback rule can apply to, and what loyalty and the nightly draw count: never a wallet top-up or an agent's traffic.

CashbackRuleRow.description: A cashback rule («کش‌بک»): this percent of what a delivered order paid goes back to the customer's wallet, for the listed order types, for members of its customer group (null: anyone) who paid with its payment method (null: any). Of the enabled rules matching an order, the highest percent applies; the customer's loyalty tier adds its own.

CashbackRuleRequest.description: A cashback rule to add or update. Every refusal is returned at once, under its field.

customer_group_id.description: A customer group of the shop; null or left out for anyone.

payment_method_id.description: The payment method the order must be paid with; null or left out for any.

enabled.description: Left out: on for a new rule, unchanged for an existing one.

LotteryPrizeKind.description: What the nightly draw gives each winner: Toman in the wallet (`wallet`), GB of `traffic` or `days` on one of their running services, or a free service of a `plan`.

LotteryDrawRow.description: One nightly draw among buyers («قرعه‌کشی شبانه»): its day, its entries, its prize (as it was then), and its winners in the order drawn.

day.description: The day it was drawn for, in the shop's time zone.

entries.description: Its entries: the paid orders of the previous 24 hours, or the buyers (one entry each).

amount.description: Toman (wallet), GB (traffic) or days (days); null for a plan.

plan.description: For a plan prize: the plan; null once it is deleted.

words.description: What it gives, as the customer reads it.

outcome.description: What they were given, as they read it.

order_id.description: For a plan prize: the order that delivered its service.

subscription_id.description: The service that got the traffic or days, or the plan's new service.

DiscountType.description: What a discount code takes off: a `percent` of the amount (capped at `max_discount` Toman when set), a `fixed` number of Toman (never more than the amount), or the whole amount (`free`).

DiscountState.description: A code's or sale's current state: `active`, switched `off`, `scheduled` (not started), `ended`, or (codes only) `used_up`.

DiscountSource.description: Where a discount came from: a timed `sale` («فروش ویژه»), the customer's `personal` percent («تخفیف اختصاصی») or their loyalty `tier` (only the largest of these three applies, never two together), or the `code` they typed, applied to the remaining amount.

DiscountLine.description: One discount applied to a price, labelled for the customer («فروش ویژه نوروز ۲۰٪», «تخفیف اختصاصی شما ۱۰٪», «سطح طلایی ۵٪», «کد NOWRUZ»).

percent.description: The percent; null for a fixed or free code.

OrderDiscountCode.description: The discount code used for an order.

id.description: Null once the code is deleted.

OrderPackageName.description: What a purchase or a renewal buys, in words — the one wording the bot and the report group use too: its plan's name, or a service the customer built («سرویس دلخواه») as «سرویس دلخواه · ۵۰ گیگ · ۳۰ روز». Extra traffic, time or devices: its service's plan's name (null for a service without a plan). Null for any other order (a wallet top-up, an agent's traffic).

DiscountCodeRow.description: A discount code («کد تخفیف») a customer types at checkout, in the bot or on the website. Stored and matched in upper case.

note.description: The admin's private note about it.

value.description: For `percent`: the whole percent; for `fixed`: Toman; null for `free`.

max_discount.description: For `percent`: the most Toman it takes off; null for no cap.

min_amount.description: The minimum order amount (after the automatic discount) for the code to apply; null for none.

order_types.description: The order types it applies to; null for every type a discount can apply to.

plans.description: The plans it applies to (for a renewal or extra, the service's plan); null for any.

servers.description: The servers it applies to (for a purchase, the chosen server; for a renewal or extra, the service's); null for any.

first_purchase_only.description: Only for customers who have not bought a service yet.

ends_at.description: When it stops applying; it may end at any hour of the day.

max_uses.description: Total uses allowed; null for no limit.

per_user.description: Uses allowed per customer; null for no limit.

uses.description: Orders made with it that are not cancelled. An unpaid order frees its use when it is cancelled or expires (see the `hold_minutes` bot setting).

DiscountCodeRequest.description: A discount code's whole form. Every refusal is returned at once, under its field. A field left out, null or blank means what its description says.

code.description: 3 to 32 letters, digits, `-` and `_`, unique within the shop. Stored in upper case, with Persian digits converted.

value.description: For `percent`: 1 to 100. For `fixed`: whole Toman above zero. Ignored for `free`.

max_discount.description: For `percent`: the cap, whole Toman above zero; blank or null for none. Ignored for other types.

min_amount.description: Whole Toman; blank or null for none.

order_types.description: At least one; null (or all of them) for every type.

plan_ids.description: Plan ids; null or empty for any.

server_ids.description: Server ids; null or empty for any.

starts_at.description: A local date and time in the shop's time zone (not the browser's), such as 2026-03-20T18:00. Blank or null: from now.

ends_at.description: The same format, after `starts_at`. Blank or null: no end.

max_uses.description: 1 or more; blank or null for no limit.

per_user.description: 1 or more; blank or null for no limit.

SaleRow.description: A timed sale («فروش ویژه»): a percent off the listed plans, for the listed order types, between its start and end. It is one of the automatic discounts; at checkout the largest applies.

name.description: The name customers see, such as «فروش ویژه نوروز».

order_types.description: Null for every type a discount can apply to.

plans.description: Null for every plan (for an extra, the service's plan counts).

SaleRequest.description: A sale's whole form. Every refusal is returned at once, under its field.

name.description: At most 64 characters.

order_types.description: At least one; null (or all of them) for every type.

plan_ids.description: Plan ids; null or empty for every plan.

starts_at.description: A local date and time in the shop's time zone, such as 2026-03-20T00:00. Blank or null: from now.

ends_at.description: The same format, after `starts_at`. Blank or null: no end.

hold_minutes.description: «کدهای تخفیف»: how many minutes an order made with a discount code may stay unpaid. After that, if untouched and no receipt is with support, it is cancelled and the code's use is freed. 0: as long as any unpaid order (two days).

support_contact.description: The Telegram id or link the bot's «پشتیبانی» screen shows; may be empty.

topup_presets.description: The amounts offered as buttons, ascending.

topup_random_count.description: How many buttons of amounts drawn at random the top-up screen offers beside the presets, 0 to 8; 0: none.

topup_random_min.description: The least a random-amount button offers, in Toman; never below `topup_min`.

topup_random_max.description: The most a random-amount button offers, in Toman; never below `topup_random_min`.

topup_random_round.description: What a random amount is rounded to, in Toman (1000: whole thousands).

topup_unique_max.description: The most added at random to a card-to-card top-up (1 to this many Toman), so every transfer is a different sum and its receipt is told apart; 0 to 9999, 0: nothing added.

wallet_transfer_enabled.description: «انتقال موجودی»: customers may send money from their wallet to another customer of the shop by their Telegram id. Off by default.

wallet_transfer_min.description: The least one wallet transfer moves, in Toman.

wallet_transfer_max.description: The most one wallet transfer moves, in Toman; never below `wallet_transfer_min`.

wallet_transfer_daily.description: The most a customer sends in a day, in Toman; 0: no daily cap.

card_protect.description: The bot's message with the card number is sent protected: it cannot be forwarded or saved. On by default.

card_to_support.description: A card-to-card payment sends the customer to support's private chat (`support_contact`) instead of showing a card: no card is picked for it (its `summary` on the payments screen says so), none of the cards' switches or daily caps holds a method back, and no receipt is awaited in the bot. Only while `support_contact` is set: emptied since, the cards are shown again. Off by default.

receipt_single.description: A customer waits for their receipt's review before sending another. On by default.

qr_enabled.description: Whether a delivered service comes with a QR code of its link.

carry_traffic.description: «تمدید سرویس»: whether a period's unused traffic is added to the renewed period (otherwise it expires when the period ends) — by the renewal method `extend` («تمدید پلن فعلی»).

renew_window_days.description: «تمدید سرویس»: a customer may renew a running service only within this many days of its deadline (or with at most `renew_window_percent` of its traffic left, or once it ended); 0 — no such rule, and with `renew_window_percent` 0 too, any time. A service with no deadline yet (waiting for its first connection) or none at all is let in by its traffic alone. Automatic renewal goes by its own days.

renew_window_percent.description: A customer may renew a running service once at most this percent of its traffic is left (beside `renew_window_days`); 0 — however much is left.

renew_extend.description: Renewal method «تمدید پلن فعلی» offered: the term on top of what is left, the traffic as `carry_traffic` says.

renew_reset_traffic.description: Renewal method «ریست حجم + افزایش روز» offered: the term on top of what is left, the traffic counted afresh (what was left is lost).
