renew_reset_time.description: Renewal method «ریست زمان + انتقال حجم» offered: the term starts afresh (what was left of it is lost), the traffic left carries over. With more than one method on, the customer picks; with none on, `extend` is what renews.

renew_default_method.description: The method automatic renewal uses (the first one offered while this one is not). By `reset_time` it waits for the last half hour before the end, so the days left are not lost; a wallet short of it is still told `auto_renew_days` ahead.

auto_renew_days.description: «تمدید خودکار»: how many days before its end a service is renewed from the wallet.

auto_renew_default.description: Whether a new service starts with auto-renewal on.

extras_enabled.description: «حجم، زمان و کاربر اضافه»: whether customers can buy extra traffic, time and devices («کاربر اضافه») for their services, at these prices or a plan's own (`PlanRow.extras`). When off, none is sold.

extra_traffic_price.description: The shop's price per GB of extra traffic, in Toman; null when only the preset amounts with their own prices are sold (no custom amount).

extra_traffic_options.description: The GB amounts offered as buttons, smallest first.

extra_traffic_min.description: The smallest custom GB amount (needs a price per GB).

extra_time_price.description: The shop's price per day of extra time, in Toman; null when only the preset periods with their own prices are sold (no custom amount).

extra_time_options.description: The day counts offered as buttons, fewest first.

extra_time_min.description: The fewest custom days (needs a price per day).

extra_devices_price.description: The shop's price per extra device (the service's IP limit) for 30 days, in Toman, charged for the days left of a service's period in use, which they last; null when only the preset counts with their own prices are sold (no custom count).

extra_devices_options.description: The device counts offered as buttons, fewest first.

extra_devices_min.description: The fewest custom devices (needs a price per device).

expiry_reminder.description: «یادآوری»: remind the customer `expiry_reminder_days` days before a service ends.

traffic_reminder.description: Remind the customer once `traffic_reminder_percent` of a service's quota is used.

expired_cleanup.description: «سرویس‌های منقضی‌شده»: an ended service — its time or traffic ran out, or its panel no longer has it — is removed from its panel and the shop by itself, `expired_cleanup_hours` after it ended (checked every 15 minutes), without a word to the customer; its orders stay. A service renewed meanwhile, switched off by support, or with an order still open (a renewal waiting for its receipt) is kept. Free test accounts go by their own rule (`test_cleanup`). Off by default.

expired_cleanup_hours.description: How many hours an ended service is kept before it is removed; 0 at once.

test_enabled.description: «اکانت تست رایگان»: customers can take a free test account with the bot's «اکانت تست» button, on a server that gives tests. What a test gets is each server's (`PUT /api/admin/servers/{id}/test-account`); in an agent's shop its traffic comes from the agent's bot.

test_per_user.description: How many tests a customer may take: for good, or within `test_period_days`. Bot admins have no quota.

test_period_days.description: The window `test_per_user` counts over, in days; 0 for good.

test_daily_limit.description: The most tests the shop gives in one day of its time zone; 0 for no cap.

test_newcomers_only.description: Only customers who never bought a service with a price can take one.

test_cleanup.description: Tests that ended are removed from their panels by themselves (checked every 15 minutes). A removed test still counts in the quota.

test_cleanup_hours.description: How many hours an ended test is kept before it is removed; 0 at once.

test_unused_days.description: While `test_cleanup` is on, after how many days a test that never connected is removed (its hours wait for the first connection); 0 never.

claim_enabled.description: «افزودن سرویس با لینک», main shop only, always present there (an agent's shop has no such switch, nor the `service_claims` group): customers can add a client made by hand on a panel to their «سرویس‌های من» by sending the bot (or the website) its subscription link or one of its configs. The first to send it gets it, and each claim is reported in the report group's «خریدها» topic; a wrong one is fixed by deleting the service from the shop only (`leave_panel`), so the right customer can send it again. A claimed service (`SubscriptionRow.claimed_at`) has no plan until its first renewal, when the customer picks one sold on its server. Off by default.

transfer_enabled.description: «انتقال سرویس»: customers may hand one of their services to another customer of the shop by their Telegram id (support transfers from the panels whatever this says). Off by default.

name_pattern.description: «نام کاربری سرویس»: the pattern a sold service's client is named by on its panel, of the variables `BotSettingsResponse.name_variables` lists and the characters a panel takes (letters, digits, `_ - . @`); `{username}_{seq}` by default.

test_name_pattern.description: The pattern a free test's client is named by; `test_{username}_{seq}` by default.

name_random.description: A buyer may take a random name for their new service instead of the pattern.

name_custom.description: A buyer may type the name of their new service (letters, digits, `_` and `-`, 3 to 32) instead of the pattern.

custom_enabled.description: «سرویس دلخواه», main shop only, always present there: customers build a service of the traffic and days they choose, each priced by its tiers, on `custom_servers`. Off by default.

custom_traffic_tiers.description: The price of a GB by tiers, the smallest `from` first: a built service's GB are priced whole at the tier they fall into.

custom_traffic_min.description: The least GB a customer may build.

custom_traffic_max.description: The most GB a customer may build.

custom_traffic_options.description: GB amounts offered as buttons, smallest first.

custom_days_tiers.description: The price of a day by tiers, the smallest `from` first.

custom_days_min.description: The least days a customer may build.

custom_days_max.description: The most days a customer may build.

custom_days_options.description: Day counts offered as buttons, smallest first.

custom_devices.description: Devices at once on a built service; 0 — unlimited.

custom_servers.description: The servers a customer may build on, by id.

referral_enabled.description: «زیرمجموعه‌گیری»: the referral program. Referral links bring new customers, and their payments earn the referrer `referral_rate` percent.

referral_renewal_rate.description: The percent a referred customer's renewal earns instead (0: renewals earn nothing).

referral_first_only.description: Only the first payment of each referred customer earns a commission.

referral_start_referrer.description: «هدیه شروع»: Toman added to the referrer's wallet for each new customer their link brings (0: none).

referral_start_invitee.description: Toman added to the new customer's own wallet (0: none).

referral_reward_every.description: «جایزه دعوت»: each time this many more of a referrer's referrals have bought, the referrer gets a free service of `referral_reward_plan_id` (0: never).

referral_reward_plan_id.description: The reward's plan (`PlanRow.id`); null for none. Required while the reward is on.

referral_alert_burst.description: «هشدار زیرمجموعه‌گیری فیک»: raise an alert when this many customers join through one link within `referral_alert_minutes` (0: never).

referral_alert_minutes.description: The window for `referral_alert_burst`, in minutes. Each kind of alert is raised at most once per window.

referral_alert_idle.description: Raise an alert when a referrer has this many referrals and none of them bought, and again at each further multiple (0: never). While an alert stands, the referrer earns no start gift and no plan reward.

report_purchases.description: «گروه گزارش‌ها»: the `report_…` switches choose which report group topics get reports. All are on until switched off.

report_agency.description: Main shop only: agency requests and traffic purchases are reported to the main shop's group, so an agent's bot has no such switch.

report_tickets.description: Support tickets and their messages (in every shop).

report_reviews.description: Reviews written on the website (in every shop).

gift_codes_enabled.description: «کد هدیه»: customers can redeem gift codes, with the bot's «🎁 کد هدیه» button or on the website. Codes can be created either way.

wheel_enabled.description: «گردونه شانس»: customers can spin the lucky wheel with the bot's «🎡 گردونه شانس» button.

wheel_cooldown_hours.description: Hours a customer waits between two spins that gave a prize.

wheel_buyers_only.description: Only customers who have bought a service can spin (bot admins always can).

wheel_cost.description: The cost of a spin from the wallet, in whole Toman; 0 for free.

cashback_enabled.description: «کش‌بک»: whether delivered orders earn cashback, from the cashback rules (`GET /cashback/rules`) and the customer's loyalty tier. When off, none is earned.

lottery_enabled.description: «قرعه‌کشی شبانه»: whether a draw among buyers runs every night.

lottery_hour.description: The hour (0 to 23, in the shop's time zone) from which the night's draw runs.

lottery_wallet.description: The prize in Toman, for a wallet prize.

lottery_traffic_gb.description: The prize in GB, for a traffic prize.

lottery_days.description: The prize in days, for a days prize.

lottery_plan_id.description: For a plan prize: the plan whose service it gives; null while none is chosen.

lottery_entries.description: One entry per paid order, or one per buyer.

lottery_exclude_agents.description: Leave agents out of the draw (bot admins and banned customers are always left out).

QrBackgroundInfo.description: The background picture QR cards are drawn on.

updated_at.description: The file's modification time (unix seconds), used to bust the preview's cache.

name_variables.description: «نام کاربری سرویس»: the variables `name_pattern` and `test_name_pattern` may hold, in the order a hint lists them. A pattern must hold `n` or `random`, or `seq` beside `username`, `tg_id` or `user_id`, so no two services are named alike.

name.description: Written in braces in a pattern: `{username}`.

description.description: What it stands for, in Persian.

example.description: Its value for a sample customer (@amir's third service, the shop's 128th; `date` today on the shop's clock), for the name a pattern would give as it is typed.

QrBackgroundRequest.description: A custom QR card background, as a browser form uploads it: a PNG, JPEG or WebP (checked by its content), up to `QrBackgroundInfo.max_bytes`.

BotSettingsRequest.description: One group of the bot's settings, saved whole (`PUT /bot/settings/{group}`), with the fields named as in BotSettingsData. Every switch and number must be sent (a missing one is refused); a text or list left out counts as blank.

BotLotterySettingsRequest.description: «قرعه‌کشی شبانه»: only the amount field of the chosen prize kind is read; the other prize fields keep their values.

lottery_wallet.description: Whole Toman, 1,000 to 100,000,000. Read for a wallet prize.

lottery_traffic_gb.description: 1 to 10000 GB. Read for a traffic prize.

lottery_days.description: 1 to 365 days. Read for a days prize.

lottery_plan_id.description: A plan id. Read for a plan prize.

wheel_cost.description: Whole Toman, 0 to 10,000,000. Thousands separators are accepted only between groups of three digits ("10,000").

BotTestAccountsSettingsRequest.description: «اکانت تست رایگان»: the switch, the quota and the clean-up. Every refusal is returned at once, under its field.

BotServiceClaimsSettingsRequest.description: «افزودن سرویس با لینک»: the switch (`BotSettingsData.claim_enabled`); a 404 in an agent's shop, which has no such group.

BotClientNamesSettingsRequest.description: «نام کاربری سرویس»: the patterns and the buyers' choices. A pattern left blank is its default; one with an unknown variable, another character, or neither `{n}` nor `{random}` nor `{seq}` beside `{username}`, `{tg_id}` or `{user_id}` (`{seq}` alone names every customer's first service alike) is refused under its field.

BotCustomServicesSettingsRequest.description: «سرویس دلخواه»: the switch, the tiers, the bounds, the buttons, the devices and the servers; a 404 in an agent's shop, which has no such group. Every refusal is returned at once, under its field.

custom_traffic_tiers.description: `from` 1 to 10000 GB, each once, at most 10; left out for none.

custom_days_tiers.description: `from` 1 to 365 days, each once, at most 10; left out for none.

PriceTier.description: A tier of a price: from `from` units on, `price` Toman a unit.

RenewalMethod.description: How a renewal adds its package: `extend` «تمدید پلن فعلی» (the term on top of what is left; the traffic as the shop carries unused traffic or not), `reset_traffic` «ریست حجم + افزایش روز» (the term on top; the traffic counted afresh), `reset_time` «ریست زمان + انتقال حجم» (the term afresh; the traffic left carried over).

ClientNameMode.description: How a buyer has their new service named: `sequential` by the shop's pattern, `random`, or `custom` (the name they type) — the latter two while the shop offers them.

topup_min.description: Toman. Thousands separators are accepted only between groups of three digits ("10,000").

renew_extend.description: At least one method must be on: a save with none is a 422 on `renew_extend`.

renew_default_method.description: One of the methods on (a 422 otherwise).

BotExtrasSettingsRequest.description: «حجم، زمان و کاربر اضافه»: the switch and the shop's price list (ExtraPricesRequest's fields, each prefixed `extra_`).

extra_traffic_price.description: Whole Toman per GB, above zero. Blank, null or left out for none: only the preset amounts with their own prices are sold.

extra_traffic_options.description: GB amounts, 1 to 10000, each once, at most 8. Left out for none.

extra_time_price.description: Whole Toman per day, above zero. Blank, null or left out for none: only the preset periods with their own prices are sold.

extra_time_options.description: Day counts, 1 to 365, each once, at most 8. Left out for none.

extra_devices_price.description: Whole Toman per device for 30 days, above zero. Blank, null or left out for none: only the preset counts with their own prices are sold.

extra_devices_options.description: Device counts, 1 to 20, each once, at most 8. Left out for none.

ExtraOption.description: An amount of extra traffic (GB), time (days) or devices offered as a button, at its own price or at the price per GB, day or device (a device's prices are for 30 days, prorated when sold).

price.description: Toman; null to charge the price per GB, day or device times the quantity.

ExtraOptionInput.description: An amount offered as a button, as a form sends it. A row with both quantity and price blank is ignored.

price.description: Whole Toman, above zero. Blank or null to use the price per GB, day or device (which must then be set).

ExtraPrices.description: A plan's own price list for extra traffic, time and devices (the shop's list is BotSettingsData's `extra_…` fields). For each kind: the unit price, the preset amounts, and the smallest and largest custom amount. A device's prices are for 30 days, charged for the days a service has left.

traffic_price.description: Toman per GB; null when only the preset amounts with their own prices are sold (no custom amount).

time_price.description: Toman per day; null when only the preset periods with their own prices are sold (no custom amount).

devices_price.description: Toman per device for 30 days; null when only the preset counts with their own prices are sold (no custom count).

ExtraPricesRequest.description: A plan's own price list for extras, as a form sends it. Refusals are reported under `extras.<field>`.

traffic_price.description: Whole Toman per GB, above zero. Blank, null or left out for none.

traffic_options.description: GB amounts, 1 to 10000, each once, at most 8. Left out for none.

time_price.description: Whole Toman per day, above zero. Blank, null or left out for none.

time_options.description: Day counts, 1 to 365, each once, at most 8. Left out for none.

devices_price.description: Whole Toman per device for 30 days, above zero. Blank, null or left out for none.

devices_options.description: Device counts, 1 to 20, each once, at most 8. Left out for none.

devices_min.description: 1 to 20 devices; left out, 1 (a list sent as before 0.4.0 sold devices).

BotExpiredServicesSettingsRequest.description: «سرویس‌های منقضی‌شده»: the automatic removal of ended services, and how long after its end a service goes.

referral_renewal_rate.description: Percent, 0 to 100: what a renewal earns instead of `referral_rate`.

referral_reward_plan_id.description: A plan id; null, blank or 0 for none, which is refused while `referral_reward_every` is above 0.

ReferralStartTrigger.description: When the referral start gift («هدیه شروع») is paid: when the new customer `join`s through the link, or when their first `purchase` is paid (by any method, but never a free service).

report_agency.description: Main shop only, where it is required; an agent's bot has no such switch.

BotChannelRow.description: A channel or group customers must join before using the bot.

username.description: Public handle without "@"; null for a private chat.

link.description: The link customers follow to join.

bot_is_admin.description: Whether the bot was an admin at the last check; it needs admin rights to see the members.

BotChannelRequest.description: A channel or group customers must join, as the admin pasted it: t.me/name, @name, or a private chat's numeric id (-100…). The bot must already be an admin there.

ReportTopicInfo.description: A topic of the report group, in the group's order.

title.description: Its name in the group, and the label of its switch.

ready.description: Whether the bot has created it in the connected group.

enabled.description: Whether its reports are on (the bot setting `report_<key>`).

ReportGroupData.description: The report group, where the bot reports to the shop's admins.

chat_id.description: A Telegram chat id (-100…), shown as is.

problem.description: What keeps reports from reaching the group; null when nothing does.

paused_until.description: Sending is paused until then (a flood limit, Telegram unreachable, or a problem with the group).

waiting.description: Reports queued but not sent yet.

link.description: The pending connect link: Telegram's add-to-group link, the equivalent command to type in the group, and when both expire.

attempt.description: The last group that tried that link and was refused, and why.

bot_username.description: The bot's username without "@"; null until the bot has run once.

ReportGroupTestResponse.description: How many test messages were queued, and how many were sent right away.

ReferralSummary.description: The referral program's settings and numbers.

renewal_rate.description: The rate for renewals, used instead of `rate`; 0: renewals earn nothing.

referred.description: Customers who joined through a link.

paid.description: The total paid out, in Toman.

alerts.description: Open alerts on referrers (`GET /referrals/alerts`). Their start gifts and plan rewards are withheld until support clears each alert.

ReferrerRow.description: A customer whose link brought someone.

earned.description: The total of the commissions credited to them.

alerts.description: Open alerts on them (0: none). Their start gifts and plan rewards are withheld meanwhile.

InviteeRow.description: A customer who joined through someone's link.

earned.description: What this customer's payments earned their current referrer (the commissions credited to that referrer).

referrer.description: Who it was credited to, as recorded when it was earned.

rate.description: The percent in force at the time.

ReferrerSort.description: The referrers list's sort keys: number of referrals (the default), amount earned, or time of the latest referral.

InviteeSort.description: The invitees list's sort keys: sign-up time (the default), or what their payments earned their referrer.

ReferralCommissionSort.description: The commissions list's sort keys: creation time (the default) or amount.

ReferralAlertReason.description: Why a referrer's referrals look fake. `burst`: the set number of them joined through the link within `referral_alert_minutes`. `idle`: the set number of them (or a further multiple) joined and none ever bought.

ReferralAlertRow.description: An alert on a referrer whose referrals look fake («هشدار زیرمجموعه‌گیری فیک»). While it is open, they earn no start gifts or plan rewards (commissions continue). Support clears it; what was withheld meanwhile is not paid later.

count.description: The number of referrals when it was raised: those in the window, or those who never bought.

AgencySettings.description: The agency program's settings (stored with the main bot's settings), set on the owner's agents page.

enabled.description: Requests are accepted and customers see the menu button. Existing agents keep their accounts and bots either way.

default_credit.description: The credit a newly approved agent gets, in Toman.

traffic_presets.description: The GB amounts an agent can buy with one tap, smallest first.

traffic_min.description: The smallest GB amount an agent can type.

term_days.description: The days a newly approved agent's agency lasts (their selling stops then); 0 for no end.

monthly_minimum.description: The Toman of traffic a newly approved agent buys each Jalali month at least (else their selling stops); 0 for none.

warn_days.description: How many days before their agency's end, or before a month ends with their minimum unmet, an agent is warned.

AgencySettingsRequest.description: The agency settings, saved whole, with the fields named as in AgencySettings. The switch and the numbers must be sent (a missing one is refused); presets left out means none.

AgencySummary.description: The agency program's numbers, shown above the lists (its settings are AgencySettings).

bots.description: Agents' bots that are running (connected and switched on).

AgencyLevelRef.description: An agency level, as other lists reference it.

price_per_gb.description: What agents on this level pay per GB of traffic for their bots, in Toman.
What agents on this level pay per GB of traffic for their bots, in Toman.

AgencyLevelRequest.description: An agency level to add or update.

name.description: Must be unique.

price_per_gb.description: Whole Toman that agents on this level pay per GB of their bot's traffic.

AgencyRequestRow.description: A customer's request to become an agent.

agent.description: Whether the customer is an agent now.

reviewer.description: Who decided it: the panel login, or a bot admin (@username or tg:<id>).

AgencyRequestSort.description: The agency requests list's sort key: creation time.

AgencyTermsRequest.description: An agent's terms, when approving a request or changing an agent: their level, how far below zero their wallet may go, and their terms of selling — each of these two left out is the program's on an approval, kept on a change.

expires_at.description: When their agency ends — their selling stops then —, as a day and an hour on the shop's clock ("2026-10-12T18:00", whatever the browser's zone); blank or null for never.

monthly_minimum.description: The Toman of traffic they buy each Jalali month at least: whole Toman, 0 for none — the program's own field (AgencySettings `monthly_minimum`), refused in its words.

AgencyStanding.description: An agent's terms of selling. Their agency ends at `expires_at`; a Jalali month on the shop's clock in which they buy less traffic than `monthly_minimum` (delivered traffic orders, refunds aside) — the month it was set or changed in aside — suspends their selling once it is over. Both are warned of `warn_days` ahead. While suspended their shop takes no purchase, renewal, extra traffic, time or devices, wallet top-up or free test, its bot, panel and existing services working on; they still buy traffic, and buying this month's minimum lifts a suspension for it.

expires_at.description: When their agency ends; null for never.

purchased.description: The Toman of traffic they bought in it so far.

ends_at.description: When it ends (the next month begins).

judged.description: Whether its purchases are held to the minimum when it ends: false without a minimum, and in the month it was set or changed.

suspension.description: Set while their selling is suspended; null while it sells.

warn_days.description: How many days ahead the end and a short month are warned of.

SellingSuspension.description: Why an agent's selling is suspended: `expired` — their agency's end passed (extending it lifts it); `minimum` — a month ended below their monthly minimum (this month's purchases reaching it lift it); `manual` — the owner suspended it (only the owner resumes it).

AgentHidden.description: What the owner keeps from an agent's shop: every server of the installation and every plan of the shop, each with `hidden`.

AgentHiddenItem.description: A server of the installation or a plan of the agent's shop, and whether the owner keeps it from that shop.

is_active.description: The server's switch; a plan's, the agent's own.

AgentHiddenRequest.description: Exactly the servers and plans to keep from the agent's shop; an empty list for none.

AgentRow.description: An agent (a main-bot customer on an agency level), with their bot.

credit_limit.description: How far below zero their wallet may go, in Toman.

balance.description: Their wallet balance in Toman; below zero while they use their credit.

bot.description: Their bot (its shop is created when they are approved).

standing.description: Their terms of selling; null without a shop.

hidden.description: How many servers and plans the owner keeps from their shop (`GET /agency/agents/{id}/hidden`).

AgentBot.description: An agent's bot: its identity, whether it runs and why not, and the traffic it can still sell.

username.description: Its username without the @; null until the agent connects its token.

title.description: The name Telegram shows for it.

connected.description: Whether it has a usable token: connected, and still decryptable.

problem.description: What keeps it from running (Telegram refused its token…).

traffic_balance.description: The traffic it can still sell, in bytes.

connected_at.description: When its token was first connected (a later new token keeps this time); null before.

TrafficShortage.description: An agent's bot whose traffic is used up or cannot cover even its smallest plan on sale. The bot offers no plan and renews no service until the agent buys traffic in the main bot.

balance.description: The traffic it can still sell, in bytes.

smallest_plan.description: The traffic its smallest plan on sale needs, in bytes; null while no plan is on sale.

traffic_shortage.description: Set when their traffic is too low to sell anything; null otherwise.

level.description: Their level; null once the agency ended.

credit_limit.description: How far below zero their main-bot wallet may go, in Toman.

balance.description: Their wallet balance in the main bot, in Toman.

TrafficLine.description: One line of an agent's traffic ledger.

type.description: `purchase`: bought. `sale`, `renewal`, `extension`: used by a sale or renewal of their bot, or by traffic the shop added to one of its services. `refund`: returned after a failed delivery or extension. `adjust`: corrected by the shop.

reviewer.description: Who made the change, for an adjustment or extension: the agent's bot, the owner's login (which anyone but the owner sees as «پشتیبانی»), or a website admin.

AgentSort.description: The agents list's sort keys: sign-up time (the default), wallet balance, the bot's traffic, or its sales (none counts as 0).

TrafficAdjustmentRequest.description: A manual adjustment of an agent's traffic (never below zero), with the note for their ledger.

gb.description: Gigabytes to add; a negative number (or text after a minus sign) takes them away.

note.description: The ledger line's note, at most 190 characters; blank for none.

delivery.description: Whether the agent was notified of their new terms; null when the terms did not change (no notice was sent).

Website.description: The website's settings, as the panel shows them. Secrets are never included, only whether one is stored.

enabled.description: When off, the Store API answers 404 for its key.

key.description: The store key, which names the shop in the API's address. Not a secret; a new key ends the old address.

base_url.description: The base address for the site's developer: APP_URL, then /api/store/v1/ and the key. Every endpoint is under it.

url.description: The site's address, without a trailing slash. Its origin may call the API from a browser.

origins.description: Other origins allowed to call it (scheme://host[:port]), such as a site in development on http://localhost:3000.

enabled.description: Customers can sign in with Telegram.

client_id.description: The Client ID @BotFather shows for the site (Bot Settings › Login Widget), as digits; null while none is set.

bot_id.description: The shop's bot's own Telegram id, shown as a hint beside the Client ID; null while unknown.

has_secret.description: A client secret is stored, so the redirect flow can exchange a code. The popup does not need one.

enabled.description: Customers can sign up with an email and a password.

mail_ready.description: Whether the installation can send email (the owner's «تنظیمات پنل › ایمیل»). Without it, email sign-up cannot be switched on and does not work.

client_id.description: The site's OAuth client id in Google Cloud (….apps.googleusercontent.com); null when Google sign-in is off.

captcha.description: The captcha the website's forms use (sign-up, password sign-in, password reset, reviews, and the site's own forms through the Store API's `POST /captcha/verify`): the chosen driver, every captcha driver with its form, and each driver's stored values or defaults (a secret as a SecretState).

values.description: Each captcha driver's values, keyed by driver.

enabled.description: The website shows approved reviews and accepts new ones (the Store API's `GET` and `POST /reviews`, which answer 404 while off). Guests can write only while a captcha is set. Off by default.

staff.description: Access for the shop's admins (customers whose role is admin) to the website's admin API, `/api/store/v1/{store}/admin/*`: the panels' daily-work operations.

enabled.description: Admins can use the admin API. Off by default.

strong_sign_in.description: Admins must sign in strongly: Telegram, Google, or a password with its second step. On by default.

grants.description: What admins may do beyond the daily work, in the grants' order. None by default.

StaffGrant.description: What each grant lets the website's admins do beyond the daily work: `catalog` (plans and categories), `wallet` (credit or debit a customer's wallet), `refunds` (refund a payment), `payments` (reject receipts waiting for review in bulk), `extend` (add days and traffic to a service), `manual_orders` (make an order for a customer by hand, free, from their wallet or paid outside the shop, delivered at once), `delete` (delete a service permanently, or hand it to another customer), `account_security` (turn off a customer's two-factor sign-in, sign them out of every device).

WebsiteRequest.description: A partial update of the website's settings; each panel card sends its own fields. Every field is optional: a field sent changes, one left out keeps its value, and an empty object changes nothing. Requirements are checked against the settings as they would be after the change (for example, switched on needs an address, sent now or already stored), with every refusal returned at once under its field. A secret sent blank keeps the stored one; `clear_<secret>` empties it.

enabled.description: Switching on needs an address, sent now or already stored.

url.description: The site's address: http(s) with a host, no ? or #, at most 255 characters. Blank for none, which is refused while the website is on.

origins.description: Other allowed origins: a list, or text as the admin types it (one per line, or comma-separated). At most 10, each http(s) with a host and optionally a port, nothing after it. Empty for none.

telegram_login.description: Switching on needs a Client ID, sent now or already stored.

telegram_client_id.description: Digits, as @BotFather shows them (Persian digits accepted). Blank for none, which is refused while Telegram sign-in is on.

email_signup.description: Customers can sign up with an email. Cannot be switched on while the installation cannot send email.

google_client_id.description: The OAuth client id Google Cloud shows (<digits>-<letters and digits>.apps.googleusercontent.com). Blank turns Google sign-in off.

reviews_enabled.description: Whether the website shows approved reviews and accepts new ones.

staff_enabled.description: Whether the shop's admins can use the admin API.

staff_strong_sign_in.description: Whether admins must sign in strongly: Telegram, Google, or a password with its second step.

staff_grants.description: The full list of grants beyond the daily work; any grant left out is not given.

WebsiteCaptchaRequest.description: The website's captcha, as its settings card sends it: the driver (`none` for none) and the driver's whole form, validated by the driver. A secret left blank or out keeps the stored one while the driver and the fields it belongs with stay the same; `clear_<name>: true` empties it. Refusals are reported under `captcha.<field>`. One closed shape per driver.

WebsiteTurnstileRequest.description: Cloudflare Turnstile: the widget's keys from the Cloudflare dashboard.

site_key.description: Public; the widget is drawn with it. At most 64 printable Latin characters.

secret_key.description: Blank: the stored secret stays, as long as the site key stays the same.

WebsiteAltchaRequest.description: ALTCHA: no keys; the shop issues and checks the challenges itself.

StoreResponse.description: The Store API's `GET /`: the shop's public profile, which a website asks for first.

name.description: The main shop's name (APP_NAME); for an agent's shop, their bot's title (else its username).

taking_orders.description: Whether the shop takes orders now: its bot is switched on, and — an agent's shop — the main shop has not suspended its selling. When false, purchases, renewals, extras and top-ups are refused (503) — receipts too while the bot is off, but not while the selling is suspended (an order made before is still paid) —, and while the selling is suspended a renewal's preview and a discount code's check for a renewal or an extra are a 422 on `status`; the catalogue can still be read (an agent's suspended shop offers no plan) and customers can still sign in.

service_claims.description: Whether a customer can add a service to their account by its link now (`POST /subscriptions/claim`, «افزودن سرویس با لینک»): the main shop's alone, while its admin switches it on (off by default). Always false in an agent's shop.

service_transfers.description: Whether a customer can hand one of their services to another customer of the shop now (`POST /subscriptions/{id}/transfer`, «انتقال سرویس»): while the shop's admin switches it on (off by default), in any shop.

custom_services.description: Whether a customer can build a service of the traffic and days they choose now («سرویس دلخواه», `GET /custom-services`): the main shop's alone, while its admin switches it on (off by default), both price lists sell and one of its servers can take a new client. Always false in an agent's shop.

name_modes.description: The ways a buyer may name their new service (`name_mode` of `POST /orders`), `sequential` (the shop's pattern) first and always; `random` and `custom` while the shop's admin offers them. Just `sequential`: ask nothing.

bot.description: The shop's Telegram bot; null while its username is unknown.

support.description: How to reach support: the bot's «پشتیبانی» contact as a link (an @handle's t.me address, a web address, or a tel: number). Null when none is set or it is not a link.

telegram.description: Telegram sign-in while it is on; null when it is off.

client_id.description: The Client ID for the site's sign-in (telegram-login.js's client_id).

redirect.description: The redirect flow is also available (a client secret is stored), so `POST /auth/telegram/authorize` works.

google.description: Google sign-in while it is on; null when it is off.

client_id.description: The OAuth client id for the site's sign-in (Google Identity Services' client_id).

email.description: Email sign-up is on and the shop can send email (so the codes reach the customer). Customers who already signed up can sign in with their password either way.

captcha.description: The website's captcha, for drawing the widget; null when none is set. Sign-up, password sign-in, password reset and reviews send its token in `captcha`, solved for the operation's action (`x-captcha`: Turnstile's data-action, or ALTCHA's challenge requested with ?action=). For the site's own forms, its backend checks the token with `POST /captcha/verify`.

site_key.description: The widget's public key (Turnstile's site key); null for ALTCHA, which has none.

challenge_url.description: Where the widget fetches its challenge: ALTCHA's challengeurl (`GET /captcha/challenge`, with ?action= naming the form's action). Null for Turnstile, which makes its own.

referral.description: The referral program's terms: a new customer who signs in with an invite code (`referral_code`) earns the code's owner a share of their payments.

rate.description: The share of a referred customer's payment, in percent.

first_only.description: Only each referred customer's first payment earns a share.

CaptchaDriver.description: A captcha a website can use: `turnstile`, Cloudflare Turnstile (its widget is drawn with the site key and its token is checked with Cloudflare); or `altcha`, ALTCHA (open source, with no third party and no keys: the visitor's browser solves a challenge the shop issues and checks itself).

CaptchaAction.description: The action a captcha widget names for a form: the shop's `sign_up`, `sign_in`, `password_reset` and `review` (each operation's `x-captcha`), or the site's own (such as `contact`). A token solved for one action does not pass a form of another. 1 to 32 of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, - and _ (Turnstile's data-action).

StoreCaptchaChallengeResponse.description: An ALTCHA challenge, in the widget's own format: a salt that carries its expiry (and the requested action), the SHA-256 of the salt plus a number up to `maxnumber`, and the shop's signature. The widget finds the number and gives the form the payload (base64 JSON), which the form sends as `captcha`.

StoreCaptchaVerifyRequest.description: A captcha token from one of the site's own forms, which the site's backend asks the shop to check, as the visitor's browser sent it.

token.description: The token the widget gave the form: Turnstile's cf-turnstile-response, or ALTCHA's payload. At most 4096 characters.

remoteip.description: The visitor's IPv4 or IPv6 address, as the site's backend saw it. Refused tokens then count against the visitor's network instead of the backend's (which all visitors share); it is also passed to the captcha provider (Turnstile's remoteip). Optional: when blank or left out, the backend's own network is counted.

StoreCaptchaVerdict.description: The result of a token check: whether it passed, the action and host it was solved for (as far as the captcha reports), when it was checked, and why it failed.

action.description: The action it was solved for, as the widget named it; null for none.

hostname.description: The host it was solved on (Turnstile reports it); null when the captcha does not report it (ALTCHA).

reasons.description: Why it failed; empty when it passed. `hostname-mismatch` (not solved on one of the website's hosts: its address and origins), `action-mismatch` (solved for another action than `action`), `timeout-or-duplicate` (expired, or already used), `invalid-input-response` (not a valid token, or tampered with), `missing-input-response`, and Cloudflare's own error codes.

nonce.description: Pass it to the provider's sign-in (telegram-login.js's nonce), then send it back once, with the id_token.

StoreTelegramAuthorizeRequest.description: Start a redirect sign-in in this browser: where Telegram sends the browser back (with the code and state), and the PKCE challenge of the verifier the site made and keeps (in sessionStorage). The shop keeps no verifier, so a code and state brought back to another browser sign nobody in.

redirect_uri.description: An http(s) address on the website's origin or one of its listed origins, without #.

code_challenge.description: S256: the SHA-256 of the verifier (43 to 128 random characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and -._~), in base64url without padding.

url.description: Telegram's authorization address to send the browser to, with client_id, redirect_uri, scope, state, the PKCE challenge (S256) and a nonce.

StoreTelegramSignInRequest.description: A Telegram sign-in: the popup's id_token with its nonce, or the redirect's code with its state and verifier.

id_token.description: The id_token telegram-login.js gave the page.

nonce.description: The nonce from `POST /auth/nonce` that the popup was opened with.

referral_code.description: The invite code the visitor came with: a new customer becomes its owner's referral. Ignored for an existing customer.

code.description: The code Telegram sent the browser back with.

state.description: The state it came back with, from `POST /auth/telegram/authorize` (a signed-in customer's state signs nobody in).

code_verifier.description: The PKCE verifier this browser made and kept when it started the sign-in, whose challenge it sent. Any other verifier signs nobody in.

referral_code.description: The invite code the visitor came with: a new customer becomes its owner's referral. Ignored for an existing customer.

StoreGoogleSignInRequest.description: A Google sign-in: the id_token Google Identity Services gave the page (its `credential`), with the nonce it was requested with.

id_token.description: The id_token Google gave the page.

nonce.description: The nonce from `POST /auth/nonce` that the sign-in was requested with.

referral_code.description: The invite code the visitor came with: a new customer becomes its owner's referral. Ignored for an existing customer.

StoreRegisterRequest.description: The first step of signing up. Every refusal is returned at once, under its field.

last_name.description: At most 64 characters; blank for none.

email.description: An email address, at most 191 characters; stored in lower case.

password.description: At least 8 characters and at most 72 bytes (a Persian letter is two bytes), taken exactly as typed, spaces included.

referral_code.description: The invite code the visitor came with: a new customer becomes its owner's referral. Ignored for an existing customer.

captcha.description: The captcha widget's token, while the website uses a captcha (`GET /` says which and how to draw it), solved for the operation's action (its `x-captcha`).

StoreVerifyRequest.description: The last step of signing up: the emailed code.

captcha.description: The captcha widget's token, while the website uses a captcha (`GET /` says which and how to draw it), solved for the operation's action (its `x-captcha`).
The captcha widget's token, while the website uses a captcha (`GET /` says which and how to draw it), solved for the operation's action (its `x-captcha`).

code.description: The six-digit emailed code (Persian digits accepted).

password.description: The new password: at least 8 characters and at most 72 bytes.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the code expires (it allows five tries).

token.description: The customer's bearer token for this device, shown only this once. The site keeps it and sends it as `Authorization: Bearer …`.

telegram.description: Their Telegram account: its numeric id and handle (without the @; null if none). Null for a customer who signed up on the website.

email.description: Their verified email (confirmed with an emailed code, or vouched for by Google); null if none.

google.description: They can sign in with a Google account.

has_password.description: They can sign in with their email and a password.

two_factor.description: Password sign-in also asks for their authenticator app's code (or a recovery code).

phone.description: The number they shared with the bot, in E.164 form (+98912…).

balance.description: Their wallet balance in Toman, as a decimal string ('120000.00'). Below zero is an agent's debt.

created_at.description: When they became a customer of the shop.

StoreAccountResponse.description: The answer of `GET /me` and `PATCH /me`: the account, the unread notification count (for a bell icon), what the admin API allows them (for an admin of the shop), and their loyalty standing.

unread_notifications.description: How many of their notifications are unread (`GET /notifications`).

staff.description: Null for a customer who is not an admin of the shop, and while the website lets no admins in.

loyalty.description: Their loyalty tier («سطح وفاداری»), what they spent and the next tier. The tier's discount applies at checkout and its cashback adds to the shop's. In a shop with no tiers, `tier` and `next` are null.

StoreStaff.description: What the website's admin API (`/admin/*`, the panel operations marked `x-staff`) allows this customer as an admin of the shop.

grants.description: What the website lets admins do beyond the daily work. An operation that needs a grant works only while the grant is listed here.

strong_sign_in.description: The website requires admins to sign in strongly: Telegram, Google, or a password with its second step.

signed_in_strongly.description: This session was signed in strongly, or a strong way in was proven on it since (`POST /me/reauthenticate`).

signed_in_until.description: Until when this session may use the admin API at all: 12 hours after a way in was last proven on it. Null: prove a way in again first (`POST /me/reauthenticate`).

recent_until.description: Until when this session's sign-in counts as recent, which granted operations and payment approval (`x-staff-recent`) also need. Null: prove a way in again first (`POST /me/reauthenticate`).

StoreSession.description: A device the customer is signed in on.

device.description: The device as its browser describes it, in words: «Chrome در Windows».

ip.description: The IP address it signed in from.

last_used_at.description: Its last request (updated every few minutes, not on every request).

current.description: The session this request was made with.

StoreTwoFactorResponse.description: The password is right, but the account needs a second step: the challenge to send with the code (`POST /auth/login/2fa`). No session is opened yet.

challenge.description: Send it back with the code; it allows five wrong codes.

StoreTwoFactorRequest.description: The second step of a password sign-in.

code.description: The current six-digit code from the account's authenticator app (Persian digits and spaces accepted), or one of its recovery codes (any case, dashes and spaces accepted).

StoreProfileRequest.description: The customer's names. Only the fields sent change. An account with Telegram takes its names from Telegram and cannot change them.

last_name.description: At most 64 characters; blank for none.

current_password.description: The current password; required when the account has one.

password.description: The new password: at least 8 characters and at most 72 bytes (a Persian letter is two bytes), taken exactly as typed.

StoreTwoFactorSetupResponse.description: A new secret for the customer's authenticator app, waiting for the app's first code.

secret.description: Base32 (160 bits), for typing into the app by hand.

uri.description: The otpauth:// address for the app, as a QR code or a link on the phone. Its issuer is the shop's name and its account name is the email.

code.description: The app's current six-digit code for the secret from `POST /me/2fa/setup` (Persian digits accepted).

StoreRecoveryCodesResponse.description: Two-factor sign-in is on. Its recovery codes, each usable once instead of the app's code, are shown only this once (the shop stores only their hashes).

recovery_codes.description: Ten codes, each 10 upper-case letters and digits without look-alikes (no 0/O, 1/I/L).

StoreTelegramLinkRequest.description: Proof of a Telegram account, as for a sign-in: the popup's id_token with its nonce, or the redirect's code with its state and verifier.

id_token.description: The id_token telegram-login.js gave the page.

nonce.description: The nonce from `POST /auth/nonce` that the popup was opened with.

code.description: The code Telegram sent the browser back with.

state.description: The state it came back with, from `POST /me/telegram/authorize` for this customer (a sign-in's or another customer's state proves nothing).

code_verifier.description: The PKCE verifier this browser made and kept when it started the sign-in, whose challenge it sent. Any other verifier signs nobody in.

StoreGoogleLinkRequest.description: Proof of a Google account, as for a sign-in: the id_token Google Identity Services gave the page, with the nonce it was requested with.

id_token.description: The id_token Google gave the page.

StoreEmailLinkRequest.description: An email to add to the account, with the password to sign in with. Every refusal is returned at once, under its field.

email.description: An email address, at most 191 characters; stored in lower case.

password.description: At least 8 characters and at most 72 bytes, taken exactly as typed.

code.description: The six-digit emailed code (Persian digits accepted).

StoreIdentityKind.description: A way to sign in: a Telegram account, a Google account, or an email (with its password).

StoreMergeOfferResponse.description: The way in being added belongs to another account of the shop. Shows that account (so the customer can confirm it is theirs too), which of the two would remain, and the ticket that merges them (`POST /me/merge`).

token.description: The merge ticket, usable once and only by this account.

name.description: "first last"; null if none.

created_at.description: When it became a customer of the shop.

telegram.description: It can sign in with Telegram.

email.description: It can sign in with an email.

google.description: It can sign in with Google.

keeps.description: The account that remains, the older one: `this` or the `other`. It takes over everything the other owns, and the other's ways in fill its empty slots.

token.description: The ticket from the merge offer.

StoreReauthenticateRequest.description: Proof of a way into this account: its password (with the second step's code while two-factor sign-in is on), its Telegram account (popup or redirect), or its Google account.

code.description: While two-factor sign-in is on: the current six-digit code from the account's authenticator app, or one of its recovery codes (which is used up), as `POST /auth/login/2fa` accepts them.

id_token.description: The id_token telegram-login.js gave the page.

nonce.description: The nonce from `POST /auth/nonce` that the popup was opened with.

code.description: The code Telegram sent the browser back with.

state.description: The state it came back with, from `POST /me/telegram/authorize` for this customer.

code_verifier.description: The PKCE verifier this browser made and kept when it started the sign-in, whose challenge it sent. Any other verifier signs nobody in.

id_token.description: The id_token Google gave the page.

expires_in.description: Seconds this session may change how the account signs in before it must prove a way in again (15 minutes).

StorePlan.description: A plan on sale now: what it gives and costs, its category, and the servers a customer can pick today.

first_purchase_price.description: The price of a customer's first purchase in the shop («قیمت خرید اول»), in Toman, below `price` ('0.00' makes it free). `POST /orders` charges it while the customer has bought no service. Null when there is none, or (with a customer's token) when that customer has already bought. Renewals are at `price`.

agent_price.description: The price for the shop's agents and members of groups with agent prices («قیمت نماینده»), in Toman, below `price`, for purchases and renewals. Null when there is none, or when the reader is a guest or a customer who gets no agent price. The checkout charges the customer's lowest price.

offer_price.description: What the reader pays today, in Toman: the lowest price that applies to them (`price`, `first_purchase_price`, `agent_price`) minus their largest automatic discount (`discount`). Equal to `price` when nothing applies. A discount code is applied on top of this at checkout.

discount.description: The automatic discount in `offer_price`: a sale on the plan, the reader's personal percent or their loyalty tier's, whichever is largest (never two together). Null for none.

checkout_note.description: A note to show at checkout («یادداشت پیش‌فاکتور»: apps it was tested with, a caveat), as plain text the site must escape. Null for none.

duration_days.description: The term in whole days, rounded up (a 6-hour plan says 1), counted from the first connection; 0 never ends. `duration_hours` is exact.

duration_hours.description: The term in hours from the first connection (a daily plan's is days × 24); 0 never ends.

devices.description: Devices at once; 0 for no limit.

category_id.description: The category it is listed under; null for the group without a category (no category, or a switched-off one).

locations.description: The servers a customer can pick today («لوکیشن» in the bot), in the plan's order; at least one.

StorePlanDiscount.description: The automatic discount on a plan for this reader: its source, its label («فروش ویژه نوروز ۲۰٪», «تخفیف اختصاصی شما ۱۰٪», «سطح طلایی ۵٪»), its percent and, for a sale, when it ends.

ends_at.description: When the sale ends; null for no end, or another source.

groups.description: Every active category in order (empty ones too), then last the plans without a category (or in a switched-off one). A shop without categories has only this last group, or no group when it sells nothing now.

category.description: Null for the group without a category («سایر پلن‌ها» in the bot).

available.description: It takes new customers now: switched on, serving subscription links, and not full.

checked_at.description: When the shop last reached it; null if never.

StoreSubscription.description: One of the customer's services, as last read from its panel (`synced_at`), with what the customer can do with it now.

name.description: Its name on the panel ("amir_2", "USER_7").

is_test.description: A free test account («اکانت تست»), taken in the bot: it has no plan and can be neither renewed nor bought extras (`extras`); the shop may remove it some time after it ends, or some days after it was made while never connected (`removes_at`).

claimed_at.description: When the customer added it to their account by its link (`POST /subscriptions/claim`, or in the bot): a service support made on the panel by hand, not sold by the shop. It has no plan until a renewal on a plan the customer picks (`GET …/renewal-plans`; a renewal with a package built leaves it without). Null for every other service.

plan.description: The plan it was sold or last renewed on; null for a service without one — a test account, a service added by its link (`claimed_at`) or built by the customer (`POST /custom-services/orders`), until a renewal on a plan (a renewal with a package built leaves it null) — or once that plan is deleted.

server.description: The server it is on («لوکیشن» in the bot).

link.description: The subscription link; null once the panel no longer has the service (deleted).

ended_at.description: When it ended: its end date passed, its traffic ran out, or its panel no longer has it. Null while it runs, and after its end date until the shop next reads its panel (`term.expires_at` says when).

removes_at.description: When the shop will remove it by itself — from its panel and from the customer's services —, by the shop's rules now; null when it will not. Set only for a service that ended (or a test account never connected) in a shop that removes such services: renewing it or adding to it before then keeps it, and the moment can move when the shop changes its rules. A moment already past: it goes at the shop's next check (every 15 minutes). A service switched off by support, or with an order still open (a renewal waiting for its receipt), is not removed.

auto_renew.description: Auto-renewal («تمدید خودکار»): the service is renewed from the wallet before it ends, on its plan at the plan's price.

offered.description: The switch can be set (`PATCH`): the service is active, has an end date and still has its plan, and the wallet payment method is on and takes the customer's renewal price (within its least and most amount; a service whose renewal it does not take is renewed by hand).

days_before.description: How many days before its end it is renewed when the switch is on — or, where the shop renews automatically by «ریست زمان» (which throws away the term left), how many days before its end a wallet short of the price is told, the renewal itself made shortly before the end. A shop-wide setting, 1 to 30.

renewable.description: The customer can renew it now on its own plan: it is active or ended, its plan still exists and the renewal adds something (in an agent's shop, covered by the agent's traffic). False for a service without a plan, which `picks_plan` covers. Whether the shop lets it be renewed yet is `renewal_window`.

picks_plan.description: The customer can renew it now on what they pick: it has no plan and is no test account (added by its link, `claimed_at`, or built), it is active or ended, and a plan on sale is sold on its server or the shop's builder is offered. List the choices with `GET …/renewal-plans` and send the plan picked as `plan_id` to `…/renewal` — that renewal makes it the service's plan, after which `renewable` is what holds —, or a package built as `gb` and `days`, after which it still picks.

renewal_window.description: Whether the shop lets the customer renew it yet («آستانه مجاز تمدید»), beside `renewable` or `picks_plan`. A shop may hold a running service back until its end date is a few days away, or until little of its traffic is left; an ended service may always be renewed. While closed, the renewal's preview and the renewal are a 422 on `status` saying from when, and the fields say what opens it — any that is set, whichever comes first. Auto-renewal goes by its own days.

open.description: It may be renewed now (as far as the window goes).

opens_at.description: While closed: the moment its end date comes within the window (that end date less the window's days); null otherwise.

days_before.description: While closed and its clock waits for its first connection (no end date yet): it opens this many days before the end date it will have; null otherwise.

traffic_percent.description: While closed: it opens once at most this percent of its traffic is left; null otherwise (unlimited traffic, or the shop holds nothing back by traffic). With no field set, only its end opens it.

devices.description: How many devices may use it at once (its IP limit, raised by extra devices); 0 for no limit.

extras.description: Whether extra traffic, extra time and extra devices («کاربر اضافه») can be bought for it now (`GET …/extras` gives the amounts and prices). All need the shop to sell them (at its prices or the plan's) and the service to be active or ended (not switched off by support, nor gone from its panel) and not a free test account. Traffic needs a quota and time not run out (a service whose traffic ran out runs again with it). Time needs a term and traffic not run out (a service whose time ran out starts again from its next connection). Devices need a device limit (an unlimited one takes none), neither time nor traffic run out (a renewal then would replace the period they are for at once), and a server whose panel enforces the limit. In an agent's shop, traffic also needs the agent's bot to have traffic left to sell.

link_rotation.description: Its link can be changed now (`POST …/rotate-link`): it is active and its server can rotate links.

next_period.description: A renewal's traffic queued after the current period. Null while none waits for the period's end: nothing renewed ahead, or a renewal whose traffic counted at once (the shop carries unused traffic over, `reset_traffic`, or unlimited traffic) — its device limit may still wait (`next_devices`).

next_devices.description: A renewal's device limit queued after the current period: a running service renewed by `extend` or `reset_traffic` keeps the devices it has (extra devices bought included) until the period in use ends, and has the renewal's from then. Null while the limit stays as `devices` says.

presence.description: Whether it is connected. Only set right after the panel was read (`POST …/refresh`) and still has it; null otherwise.

online.description: Connected right now; null when the panel cannot tell.

last_online_at.description: Its last connection; null if never, or when the panel cannot tell.

synced_at.description: When the panel was last read for it; the numbers are from then.

StoreServiceTraffic.description: A service's quota, and how much is used and left, in bytes.

StoreServiceTerm.description: A service's term: its length, when it started and when it ends, or that it waits for the first connection.

duration_days.description: The term in whole days, rounded up, counted from the first connection; 0 never ends. `duration_hours` is exact.

duration_hours.description: The term in hours, counted from the first connection; 0 never ends.

starts_at.description: When the first connection started the term; null until then.

expires_at.description: Null while it waits for the first connection, or without a term.

awaits_first_use.description: The term has not started yet; it starts at the first connection.

StoreNextPeriod.description: A renewal queued after the current period (whose unused traffic is not carried over): when the current period ends, and the most traffic left then, in bytes.

NextDevices.description: A device limit a renewal queued after the current period: from when (the current period's end) and how many devices at once then.

StoreRecipient.description: Another customer of the shop as this customer can tell them — whom a service («انتقال سرویس») or money («انتقال موجودی») goes, or went, to: their Telegram name and handle, nothing else of their account.

name.description: Their name in Telegram; null when they show none.

username.description: Their Telegram handle, without the @; null when they have none.

StoreTransferRecipientResponse.description: «انتقال سرویس» or «انتقال موجودی»: who the service or the money goes (or went) to.

StoreClaimRequest.description: A service's link, as the customer sent it, to add the service to their account.

link.description: A subscription link or one of the service's configs, alone or among other words (its links are read together, five at most).

StorePayment.description: A payment attempt for an order.

receipt.description: The receipt the customer sent for it, in the bot or on the website; null if none was sent.

note.description: The note on its latest decision, as the bot shows it to the customer: support's (a rejection's reason, or a cancellation or refund note) or the shop's own (the order paid another way, left unpaid, or its service handed to another customer); null if none.

StoreOrder.description: One of the customer's orders: what it was for, its status, and its payments (newest first).

discount_amount.description: The total its discounts took off (the automatic one and the code's), in Toman; 0 for none. `amount` is after discounts.

discounts.description: The discounts applied, the automatic one first.

discount_code.description: The discount code used; null for none.

plan.description: The plan of a purchase or renewal (for extras, the service's plan); null for a wallet top-up, a service the customer built, or once the plan is deleted.

server.description: Where a purchase was bought; for a renewal or extras, the service's server. Null for none.

subscription.description: The service it is about, by its panel name (for a renewal or extras from the start, for a purchase once delivered); null for none, or once the service is deleted.

traffic_bytes.description: The traffic it adds, in bytes: a service's extra traffic, a built service's traffic, or an agent's traffic for their bot (`traffic` orders); null otherwise.

days.description: The extra days it adds to its service, or a built service's term; null otherwise.

devices.description: The devices it adds to its service's IP limit (extra devices), or a built service's limit; null otherwise.

StorePaymentMethod.description: A payment method, as the checkout shows it.

kind.description: `instant`: the wallet, paid at once. `manual`: a card transfer with a receipt. Null for a method whose driver is no longer installed.

min_amount.description: The least amount to pay it takes, in Toman; null for no least.

max_amount.description: The most amount to pay it takes, in Toman; null for no most. An order outside the bounds is a 422 on `method_id`.

methods.description: In checkout order; empty when no method can pay this kind of order.

StoreOrderRequest.description: A purchase: the plan, the location to buy it on, and the payment method.

discount_code.description: A discount code the customer typed (any case, Persian digits accepted), applied after the automatic discount. A 422 on `discount_code` when it does not apply to this order. Blank, null or left out for none. Each code that does not apply uses one of the customer's 20 tries an hour (then a 429). A repeated request with the same key returns its order, whatever the code says now.

StoreNameModeInput.description: How the new service is named on its panel: `sequential` (left out: the default) by the shop's pattern; `random`, a name drawn now; `custom`, `client_name`. Only a way `shop.name_modes` of `GET /` offers; another is a 422 on `name_mode`. A random name is worked out from the `Idempotency-Key`, so two requests sent with one key at once ask the same; a request repeated with its key asks the name its order was made with, and is not refused for what took that name since.

StoreClientNameInput.description: For `custom`: the name the customer typed, 3 to 32 English letters, digits, `_` and `-`. A 422 on `client_name` for another character or length, for one that server's panel does not take (a PasarGuard server: two of `_` and `-` side by side), or for a name a service on that server already has. Should a service (or a client made by hand on the panel) take it before the order is delivered, the service is named by the shop's pattern instead. Ignored for the other ways.

StoreDiscountCheckRequest.description: A discount code and what the customer wants to buy with it, named as in the checkout's own request.

code.description: As the customer typed it (any case, Persian digits accepted).

plan_id.description: For a purchase: a plan on sale now (`GET /plans`). For a renewal of a service without a plan: the plan picked (`GET …/renewal-plans`).

server_id.description: For a purchase: one of the plan's `locations`. A code limited to certain servers is refused until one is picked.

subscription_id.description: For a renewal or extra: the customer's service.

method.description: For a renewal: the renewal method, as the renewal would send it (a 422 on `method` for one the shop does not offer).

gb.description: For extra traffic: how many GB. For a renewal with a package built (instead of `plan_id`): its GB.

days.description: For extra time: how many days. For a renewal with a package built: its days.

StoreQuote.description: A price before anything is ordered, as the order would be made at it: the base, each discount taken off it, and what is left to pay.

base.description: Toman before discounts: the customer's price for what they mean to buy — a plan's price, first-purchase price or agent price; an extra amount's cost; a built service's two prices added.

discounts.description: The automatic discount, if any, then the code.

amount.description: Toman left to pay, never below zero; 0 means free.

StoreCustomServices.description: «سرویس دلخواه» as a customer meets it: each quantity's tiers, bounds and buttons, the devices and the servers. While nothing is `offered`, each quantity's `tiers` and `options` are empty.

offered.description: Whether a service may be built now (`shop.custom_services` of `GET /`).

traffic.description: The GB: `from` and the bounds in GB, a tier's `price` per GB.

days.description: The days: `from` and the bounds in days, a tier's `price` per day.

devices.description: Devices at once on a built service; 0 — unlimited.

servers.description: The servers a service may be built on now, in order; empty while nothing is offered.

StoreCustomQuantity.description: One quantity of a built service. Any whole amount from `min` to `max` may be chosen; it is priced whole at the `price` of the last tier whose `from` it reaches (50 with tiers from 1 at 3000 and from 50 at 2500 costs 50 × 2500). The tiers start at `min`: none prices an amount outside the bounds.

tiers.description: The smallest `from` first; empty while it is not priced, or nothing is offered.

options.description: The amounts offered as buttons, smallest first, each within the bounds; empty while nothing is offered.

StoreCustomQuoteRequest.description: A service the customer would build.

gb.description: How many GB, within the bounds of `GET /custom-services`.

days.description: How many days, within the bounds of `GET /custom-services`.

server_id.description: One of `servers` of `GET /custom-services`, once picked: a code limited to certain servers holds only then.

discount_code.description: A discount code to check with it (any case, Persian digits accepted). Blank, null or left out for none.

quote.description: What the service would give and cost: its GB, days and devices, each quantity's price, and the price as a `StoreQuote` (`base` is the two prices added).

devices.description: Devices at once on the service; 0 — unlimited.

server_id.description: The server named; null for none.

traffic_price.description: Toman: the GB at their tier's rate.

days_price.description: Toman: the days at their tier's rate.

base.description: Toman before discounts: the customer's price for what they mean to buy — a plan's price, first-purchase price or agent price; an extra amount's cost; a built service's two prices added.

discounts.description: The automatic discount, if any, then the code.

amount.description: Toman left to pay, never below zero; 0 means free.

StoreCustomOrderRequest.description: A service the customer builds, the server to build it on, how to name it, and the payment method.

gb.description: How many GB, within the bounds of `GET /custom-services`.

days.description: How many days, within the bounds of `GET /custom-services`.

server_id.description: One of `servers` of `GET /custom-services`; it may be left out while there is only one.

discount_code.description: A discount code the customer typed (any case, Persian digits accepted), applied after the automatic discount. A 422 on `discount_code` when it does not apply to this order. Blank, null or left out for none. Each code that does not apply uses one of the customer's 20 tries an hour (then a 429). A repeated request with the same key returns its order, whatever the code says now.

StoreRenewalRequest.description: A service's renewal: the payment method, the plan (or a package built) for a service without one, and the renewal method.

method.description: How the renewal adds its plan, one of the preview's `methods`; left out, the first of them. One the shop does not offer is a 422 on `method`. With an `Idempotency-Key`, a retry by another method than the key's order is a 422 on `idempotency_key`.

plan_id.description: For a service without a plan (`picks_plan`): the plan to renew it on, one of `GET …/renewal-plans` (a 422 on `plan_id` when missing or not among them); it becomes the service's plan. For a service with its own plan it may be left out; sent, it must be that plan (a 422 on `plan_id` otherwise), so a page drawn before the service's first renewal never pays for a plan it did not show. With an `Idempotency-Key`, a retry naming another plan than the key's order is a 422 on `idempotency_key`.

gb.description: For a service without a plan, instead of `plan_id` while the builder is offered for it (`custom_services` of `GET …/renewal-plans`): the GB of a package the customer builds, within the bounds of `GET /custom-services`, with `days`. The renewal is priced by the builder's tiers, gives the builder's devices, and leaves the service without a plan. A 422 on `status` while the builder is not offered; on `gb` or `days` as the builder refuses them, or for a service renewed on its own plan; on `plan_id` sent with them.

days.description: With `gb`: the days of that package, within the bounds of `GET /custom-services`.

discount_code.description: A discount code the customer typed (any case, Persian digits accepted), applied after the automatic discount. A 422 on `discount_code` when it does not apply to this order. Blank, null or left out for none. Each code that does not apply uses one of the customer's 20 tries an hour (then a 429). A repeated request with the same key returns its order, whatever the code says now.

StoreExtraTrafficRequest.description: Extra traffic for a service: how much, and the payment method.

gb.description: Whole GB, as `GET …/extras` offers: one of its amounts, or within its `custom` range.

method_id.description: A payment method for extra traffic (`GET /payment-methods?for=extra_traffic`).

discount_code.description: A discount code the customer typed (any case, Persian digits accepted), applied after the automatic discount. A 422 on `discount_code` when it does not apply to this order. Blank, null or left out for none. Each code that does not apply uses one of the customer's 20 tries an hour (then a 429). A repeated request with the same key returns its order, whatever the code says now.

StoreExtraTimeRequest.description: Extra time for a service: how many days, and the payment method.

days.description: Whole days, as `GET …/extras` offers: one of its amounts, or within its `custom` range.

method_id.description: A payment method for extra time (`GET /payment-methods?for=extra_time`).

discount_code.description: A discount code the customer typed (any case, Persian digits accepted), applied after the automatic discount. A 422 on `discount_code` when it does not apply to this order. Blank, null or left out for none. Each code that does not apply uses one of the customer's 20 tries an hour (then a 429). A repeated request with the same key returns its order, whatever the code says now.

StoreExtraDevicesRequest.description: Extra devices for a service: how many, and the payment method.

devices.description: Whole devices, as `GET …/extras` offers: one of its amounts, or within its `custom` range.

method_id.description: A payment method for extra devices (`GET /payment-methods?for=extra_devices`).

discount_code.description: A discount code the customer typed (any case, Persian digits accepted), applied after the automatic discount. A 422 on `discount_code` when it does not apply to this order. Blank, null or left out for none. Each code that does not apply uses one of the customer's 20 tries an hour (then a 429). A repeated request with the same key returns its order, whatever the code says now.

traffic.description: Extra traffic in GB; null when none can be bought now.

time.description: Extra time in days; null when none can be bought now.

devices.description: Extra devices (the IP limit); null when none can be bought now. Their prices are for the days left of the period in use (`days`), which they last.

StoreExtraOffer.description: What a service can buy of one extra: the preset amounts with their prices and, when there is a unit price, any amount within `custom`. Devices are priced for 30 days and charged for the days left of the period in use (`days`), which they last: every price here is already that share, rounded up to whole Toman.

price.description: Toman per GB, per day or per device (for the days left of the period in use); null when only the preset amounts are sold. A custom count of devices is prorated as a whole, so it may cost a few Toman less than this times the count.

custom.description: Any amount in this range can be bought at `price` per unit; null when only the preset amounts are sold.

days.description: For devices: the days their prices are charged for, which they last — what is left of the period in use (whole days, at least 1) until its end date, or until a renewal bought before then begins; its whole term while it waits for its first connection; or 30 for one that never ends. Null for traffic and time.

StoreTopUpRequest.description: A wallet top-up: how much, and the payment method.

amount.description: Whole Toman, within the `top_up` limits of `GET /wallet`. As a customer types it (a JSON number or text; Persian digits, thousands separators and «تومان» accepted), or in the API's own amount format ("50000.00", with a zero fraction).

method_id.description: A payment method for top-ups, any but the wallet itself (`GET /payment-methods?for=wallet_topup`).

StoreReceiptRequest.description: A card transfer's receipt, as a browser form uploads it.

file.description: The picture: a JPEG, PNG or WebP (checked by its content), at most 10 MB.

note.description: An optional note for support, at most 1024 characters; blank for none.

StoreCheckout.description: The outcome of a checkout (a purchase, renewal, extra traffic, time or devices, or top-up). A checkout that paid nothing is a refusal instead: a wallet short of the price (a 422 on `method_id`, saying how much is missing), or an order paid or closed at the same moment elsewhere (a 409).

outcome.description: `settled`: paid at once (by the wallet). The order is `fulfilled` (the service is in `subscription`) or `failed` (the money is taken and support will finish it; the order's internal notes are never shown). Also returned when a repeated request's order was paid since (by card too) and is finished: delivered, failed or `refunded`. `transfer`: transfer to the card in `transfer`, then upload the receipt (`POST /payments/{id}/receipt`); the payment waits for the receipt, or support has it. `processing`: paid, and the delivery is in progress.
