transfer.description: For `transfer`: where to send the money, and the payment the receipt is for. Null otherwise. A payment taken in support's private chat (made while the bot setting «هدایت پرداخت کارت به کارت به پیوی پشتیبانی» is on) is shown no card: `card`, `holder` and `bank` are null and `contact` says where to go — tell the customer to send the order's number there, get the card from support, and send the receipt to support too; support approves the payment in its panel.

payment_id.description: The payment to upload the receipt for.

amount.description: The amount to transfer, in Toman: the payment's own. A wallet top-up's may be a few Toman more than the order's (the bot setting of a random sum added to card-to-card top-ups), so its receipt is told apart; the whole of it is credited.

card.description: The card number: 16 digits, no separators. Each payment is shown one of its method's cards, picked at random, and always that one after — the same card on a request made again. Null while the card is given in support's private chat (`contact`).

holder.description: The card holder's name. Null while the card is given in support's private chat (`contact`).

bank.description: The shop's word for the card, such as its bank; null for none, and while the card is given in support's private chat.

instructions.description: The shop's payment instructions (the method's note), shown with the card or with the way to support, as the bot shows them; null if none.

contact.description: While the shop takes card payments in support's private chat: how to reach support. Null while the card is shown.

text.description: Support's contact as the shop wrote it (a Telegram handle, a link, a phone number).

url.description: It as a link to open: a handle as its t.me address, a web or t.me address, a phone number as `tel:`; null when it is none of these.

subscription.description: Once delivered: the service a purchase created, a renewal renewed or extras were added to. Null otherwise, and on a repeated request once the service is no longer the customer's (handed to another customer).

StoreRenewal.description: A preview of a service's renewal: on its own plan (or, for a service without one, the plan picked — or the package built, `custom`), at its price today, by a renewal method among those the shop offers, and the service as the renewal would leave it by that method. It uses the last numbers read from the panel; the renewal itself reads the panel when it is paid.

method.description: The method this preview — and `after` — is by: the one asked for (`method`), else the first the shop offers.

methods.description: The methods the shop offers, in this order; the price is the same by each. With more than one, let the customer pick and send it as `method` to the preview and the renewal; with one, there is nothing to pick.

plan.description: The service's own plan, or the one picked (`plan_id`) for a service without one, which the renewal uses: what a renewal gives, as the catalogue says it (`StoreRenewalPlan` without the prices). Null for a package built (`custom`).

checkout_note.description: A note to show at checkout, as plain text; null for none.

duration_days.description: Whole days, rounded up; 0 never ends.

devices.description: Devices at once the renewal gives; 0 for no limit — whatever the service has now, extra devices bought included. A running service renewed by `extend` or `reset_traffic` keeps its devices until the period in use ends, and has these from then; any other has them at once (one still waiting for its first connection with the extra devices bought for it on top).

custom.description: The package a service without a plan is renewed with instead (`gb` and `days`): what it gives — its GB, its days and the builder's devices — and each quantity's price by the builder's tiers (`GET /custom-services`). Null for a renewal on a plan.

devices.description: Devices at once it gives; 0 — unlimited. From when, as a plan's `devices`.

traffic_price.description: Toman: the GB at their tier's rate.

days_price.description: Toman: the days at their tier's rate.

price.description: What the renewal costs the customer, in Toman: the plan's agent price for an agent or a «همکار» group member, else its price — or the package's two prices added (only a sale of every plan reaches it, and a code limited to certain plans never does) —, minus their largest automatic discount (`discounts`). A discount code is applied on top of this when paying (`discount_code`).

discounts.description: The automatic discount in `price`: none, or one.

after.description: The service as the renewal would leave it by `method`, in StoreSubscription's shapes. By `extend` remaining days carry over, and a period's unused traffic expires when the period ends unless the shop carries it over (see `next_period`); by `reset_traffic` remaining days carry over and the traffic starts afresh; by `reset_time` the term starts afresh and the traffic left carries over.

next_period.description: The current period, whose unused traffic expires when it ends; null when nothing expires.

next_devices.description: The renewal's device limit, when it waits for the current period's end; null when the service has it at once, or it is the one it has.

StoreRenewalPlan.description: A plan a service can be renewed on: what a renewal on it gives, its price, and what the renewal costs the customer today.

checkout_note.description: A note to show at checkout, as plain text the site must escape; null for none.

renewal_price.description: What renewing on it costs the customer today, in Toman: the plan's agent price for an agent or a «همکار» group member, else its price, minus their largest automatic discount (`discounts`). A discount code is applied on top of this when paying. The preview (`GET …/renewal?plan_id=`) says the same.

discounts.description: The automatic discount in `renewal_price`: none, or one.

traffic_gb.description: Gigabytes a renewal adds, decimals allowed; 0 for unlimited.

duration_days.description: Whole days, rounded up; 0 never ends. `duration_hours` is exact.

devices.description: Devices at once once renewed on it; 0 for no limit.

plans.description: In the catalogue's order; empty while the service cannot be renewed now: not at all, not yet (its renewal window), or a renewal of it under way.

custom_services.description: Whether the service may be renewed instead with a package the customer builds («🛠 تمدید با سرویس دلخواه»): it has no plan, is no test account, may be renewed now (as `plans`), and the shop's builder is offered (`shop.custom_services` of `GET /`). Then send `gb` and `days` — within the bounds and tiers of `GET /custom-services` — to `…/renewal` in place of `plan_id`.

StoreWalletResponse.description: The customer's wallet. Amounts in Toman, as decimal strings.

balance.description: Below zero is an agent's debt.

credit.description: How far below zero an agent's wallet may go; '0.00' for everyone else.

spendable.description: What the wallet can pay now: the balance plus the credit.

transfer.description: «انتقال موجودی»: what the customer may send another customer of the shop now (`POST /wallet/transfer`), as the bot's «💸 انتقال موجودی» offers it; null while the shop offers none (off by default). Only the wallet's own balance is sent, never an agent's credit.

daily_cap.description: The most a customer sends in a day, on the shop's clock; null when the shop sets no cap.

left_today.description: What the daily cap leaves this customer today; null without a cap.

most.description: The most they may send now: `max`, their balance (never below '0.00') and `left_today`, whichever is least. Below `min`, they can send nothing now.

top_up.description: The top-up limits, presets and random amounts, as the bot's «افزایش موجودی» offers them. `POST /wallet/top-up` accepts these amounts exactly as written here.

presets.description: The amounts offered as buttons, ascending.

random.description: Amounts drawn at random for this answer, offered as buttons after the presets, ascending: as many as the shop's settings ask (none by default), each within the shop's range for them and never below `min`, rounded as the shop asks, none twice and none a preset. Each answer draws anew.

StoreWalletTransferRequest.description: «انتقال موجودی»: whom to send money to — a customer of the shop, by their numeric Telegram id; they must have started the bot once — and how much.

telegram_id.description: Their numeric Telegram id: a number, or its digits as typed.

amount.description: Whole Toman, from `transfer.min` to `transfer.most` of `GET /wallet`. As a customer types it (a JSON number or text; Persian digits, thousands separators and «تومان» accepted), or in the API's own amount format ("50000.00", with a zero fraction).

StoreWalletTransaction.description: A line of the customer's wallet ledger.

description.description: What it was for («شارژ کیف پول (سفارش #12)»).

code.description: The gift code as the customer typed it.

gift.description: What the code gave the customer.

words.description: What it gave, as the customer reads it: «۵۰٬۰۰۰ تومان شارژ کیف پول», «سرویس «یک‌ماهه»».

balance.description: The new wallet balance in Toman; null for a plan code.

order.description: For a plan code: the order that delivers its service (delivered, or failed and waiting for support's retry, like any order). Null for a Toman code.

subscription.description: For a plan code: the service, once delivered.

enabled.description: The program is on: each new customer their code brings earns them a share of that customer's payments.

renewal_rate.description: The share for renewals, in percent, used instead of `rate`; 0: renewals earn nothing.

first_only.description: Only each referred customer's first payment earns a share.

start_gift.description: «هدیه شروع»: Toman added to their wallet for each new customer their code brings, and to the new customer's wallet, once per new customer. Null when there is none. Nothing is given while support has an open alert on their referrals.

invitee.description: Toman for the new customer's wallet ("0.00": nothing).

reward.description: «جایزه دعوت»: each time `every` more of the customers their code brought have bought, they get a free service of `plan`. Null when there is none.

code.description: Their invite code, which sign-ins accept as `referral_code` (the site can build its own invite link with it).

bot_link.description: The bot's invite link with their code (https://t.me/<bot>?start=ref_<code>); null while the bot's username is unknown.

invited.description: How many customers their code brought.

earned.description: The total of the commissions credited to them, in Toman.

rewards.description: How many free services they got for their invitations («جایزه دعوت»).

StoreNoticeType.description: The kind of notice; one for each message the bot sends a customer on its own. Payments: approved (the service delivered or the wallet charged, or the delivery failed and support will finish it), receipt rejected, order cancelled by support, payment refunded to the wallet, wallet top-up refunded, payment reminder. «انتقال موجودی»: money they sent another customer from their wallet (kept here whichever door they used; in Telegram only when they sent it from the website), money another customer sent them. Services: switched off, back on, deleted, moved (with its new link), given away by support («انتقال سرویس», to its previous owner) or received from another customer (to its new one), given days or traffic; reminders («یادآوری») of a service ending soon or running low on traffic; auto-renewal («تمدید خودکار») done, short of money, or paid but not delivered. Referrals: a new customer joined through their link, a commission, a start gift («هدیه شروع», for the referrer or the new customer), a free service for invitations («جایزه دعوت»). Agency: request approved or rejected, agency changed or ended, the bot's traffic too low for an order. Account security: two-factor sign-in turned off (by support or by them) or on, a way in added or removed, a password set, another account merged into it, the second step locked after failed codes, emailed codes locked after failures (these go to every channel they have: Telegram and email). Tickets: support's answer, and closing. Rewards: moved up a loyalty tier («سطح وفاداری»), cashback earned («کش‌بک»), won the nightly draw («قرعه‌کشی شبانه»).

StoreNotification.description: A notification the bot sent the customer, with the same text as the Telegram message (sent, or that would have been sent).

text.description: The text without markup: line breaks kept, a premium emoji as its plain emoji.

html.description:
The text as safe HTML: only b/strong, i/em, u/ins, s/strike/del, code, pre, blockquote, a spoiler as , links to http(s) addresses ( with no other attribute) and
for line breaks; all text is escaped. Safe to insert into a page as is.

subject.description: What it is about, for linking: one of their orders (`GET /orders/{id}`; a payment notice points to its order), services (`GET /subscriptions/{id}`) or tickets (`GET /tickets/{id}`). Null for notices about their account, a deleted service, or someone else's row. Only a service may be gone since (a 404, when support deleted it); orders and tickets stay (an unpaid order expires as `cancelled`).

unread.description: How many of their notifications are unread, regardless of the page.

StoreNotificationsReadRequest.description: The notifications to mark as read, by id (at most 100). Without `ids` (`{}`), all of them.

unread.description: How many of their notifications are still unread.

StoreTicket.description: One of the customer's support tickets.

subscription.description: Their service it is about, by its name; null for none, or when the service was deleted.

last_message_at.description: When its latest message was written; the list is sorted by it.

unread.description: Support wrote since they last read it (`POST /tickets/{id}/read` marks it read, as does viewing it in the bot).

rating.description: Their rating after it closed, 1 to 5; null for none, and after it is reopened.

closed_at.description: When it was closed; null unless it is closed (reopening clears it).

StoreTicketMessage.description: A message in their ticket, from them or from support (the support person is never named; it shows as «پشتیبانی»).

body.description: Its text as plain text, with line breaks kept.

StoreTicketDetail.description: One of the customer's support tickets, with its whole conversation, oldest message first.

subscription.description: Their service it is about, by its name; null for none, or when the service was deleted.

last_message_at.description: When its latest message was written; the list is sorted by it.

unread.description: Support wrote since they last read it (`POST /tickets/{id}/read` marks it read, as does viewing it in the bot).

rating.description: Their rating after it closed, 1 to 5; null for none, and after it is reopened.

closed_at.description: When it was closed; null unless it is closed (reopening clears it).

rating_note.description: The note they left with their rating.

unread.description: How many of all their tickets have unread messages from support, regardless of the filters (for a badge).

StoreTicketRequest.description: A new ticket: its subject, its first message, and optionally the customer's service it is about. To attach a picture, send a form instead (StoreTicketUploadRequest).

body.description: 1 to 4000 characters; line breaks are kept.

subscription_id.description: One of the customer's services (`GET /subscriptions`). Left out, null or blank: about no service.

StoreTicketUploadRequest.description: A new ticket with a picture in its first message, as a browser form uploads it. A form without a file opens it without a picture.

body.description: 1 to 4000 characters; line breaks are kept.

subscription_id.description: One of the customer's services (`GET /subscriptions`). Left out, null or blank: about no service.

file.description: The picture: a JPEG, PNG or WebP (checked by its content), at most 10 MB. Optional.

StoreTicketRatingRequest.description: The customer's rating of a closed ticket. It replaces any earlier rating.

note.description: An optional note, at most 500 characters; blank for none.

StoreReview.description: An approved review, as the website shows it: the writer's text and choices as plain text (the website must escape it), with nothing about who wrote it or who approved it.

name.description: The name it is signed with.

body.description: Its text, with line breaks as written.

context.description: A line on where the service is used («ایرانسل · اندروید · Happ»); null for none.

avatar.description: The key of the avatar they picked from the website's own set; null for none (the website shows its default).

summary.description: Totals over all approved reviews, regardless of the page.

average.description: The average rating, to two decimals; null while there are no reviews.

StoreReviewRequest.description: A review written on the website. Every refusal is returned at once, under its field.

name.description: The name to sign it with, shown with the review: 2 to 64 characters, one line.

body.description: 10 to 600 characters; line breaks are kept.

context.description: A line on where the service is used, such as «ایرانسل · اندروید · Happ»; at most 100 characters, blank for none.

avatar.description: The key of one of the website's own avatars (1 to 32 of a-z, 0-9, - and _, never an address); blank for none.

captcha.description: The captcha widget's token, while the website uses a captcha (`GET /` says which and how to draw it), solved for the operation's action (its `x-captcha`).
